=== FILE: api\check-attendance.ts ===
import type { VercelRequest, VercelResponse } from "@vercel/node";
import { loadConfig } from "../lib/config.js";
import { getClient, listKnownUsers } from "../lib/supabase.js";
import { createTelegramClient } from "../lib/telegram.js";
import { mapQllByUser, nameToCore, usernameToCore } from "../lib/qllmap.js"; // Import bá»™ bĂ³c LĂµi

// HĂ m tĂ­nh Ä‘á»™ tÆ°Æ¡ng Ä‘á»“ng (Dice's Coefficient)
// VĂ¬ nameToCore vĂ  usernameToCore Ä‘Ă£ tá»± Ä‘á»™ng xĂ³a dáº¥u & viáº¿t thÆ°á»ng, ta Ä‘á» trá»±c tiáº¿p luĂ´n.
function getSimilarity(s1: string, s2: string): number {
  if (s1 === s2) return 1.0; 
  if (s1.length < 2 || s2.length < 2) return 0.0;

  let bigrams1 = new Set();
  for (let i = 0; i < s1.length - 1; i++) bigrams1.add(s1.substring(i, i + 2));
  
  let bigrams2 = new Set();
  for (let i = 0; i < s2.length - 1; i++) bigrams2.add(s2.substring(i, i + 2));

  let intersection = 0;
  for (let item of bigrams1) {
    if (bigrams2.has(item)) intersection++;
  }

  return (2.0 * intersection) / (bigrams1.size + bigrams2.size);
}

export default async function handler(
  req: VercelRequest,
  res: VercelResponse
): Promise<void> {
  if (req.method !== "POST") {
    res.status(405).json({ error: "Method not allowed" });
    return;
  }

  try {
    const { students } = req.body;
    if (!Array.isArray(students) || students.length === 0) {
      res.status(200).json({ success: true, message: "KhĂ´ng cĂ³ há»c sinh nĂ o cáº§n bĂ¡o cĂ¡o." });
      return;
    }

    const config = loadConfig();
    const supabase = getClient(config.supabaseUrl, config.supabaseKey);
    const telegram = createTelegramClient(config.botToken);
    const TARGET_GROUP_ID = -1002273179613; 

    const { users: knownUsers } = await listKnownUsers(supabase);

    for (const s of students) {
      const qllNameFromSheet = s.qll_name || "";
      let finalUsername = "";

      // 1. DĂ¹ng luá»“ng gá»‘c cá»§a project: Thá»­ tĂ¬m khá»›p 100% full_name hoáº·c LĂµi trĂ¹ng tuyá»‡t Ä‘á»‘i
      const match = mapQllByUser(qllNameFromSheet, knownUsers);
      
      if (match.kind === "found") {
        finalUsername = match.username; 
      } else {
         // 2. LOGIC NĂ‚NG Cáº¤P: BĂ³c LĂµi tá»« sheet vĂ  LĂµi tá»« DB Ä‘em Ä‘i Ä‘á» mix > 85-90%
         const targetCore = nameToCore(qllNameFromSheet); // VD: "quyennd1"
         
         let bestMatch = null;
         let highestSimilarity = 0;

         for (const user of knownUsers) {
             const dbCore = usernameToCore(user.username); // VD: VH_QuyenDD1 -> "quyendd1"
             
             const sim = getSimilarity(targetCore, dbCore);
             if (sim > highestSimilarity) {
                 highestSimilarity = sim;
                 bestMatch = user;
             }
         }

         // Set ngÆ°á»¡ng 0.85 (85%) Ä‘á»ƒ báº¯t dĂ­nh case lá»‡ch 1 kĂ½ tá»± giá»¯a quyennd1 vs quyendd1
         if (bestMatch && highestSimilarity >= 0.85) {
             finalUsername = bestMatch.username;
             console.log(`Fuzzy Match: ${targetCore} ~ ${usernameToCore(bestMatch.username)} (${Math.round(highestSimilarity*100)}%) -> @${bestMatch.username}`);
         } else {
             // 3. Dá»± phĂ²ng cuá»‘i cĂ¹ng náº¿u há»¥t toĂ n bá»™
             finalUsername = qllNameFromSheet.replace(/^@/, "").replace(/\s+/g, "");
         }
      }

      // 4. Báº¯n thĂ´ng bĂ¡o
      const text = [
        `Há»c sinh: ${s.student_name} (${s.student_id})`,
        `MĂ£ lá»›p: ${s.class_code}`,
        ``,


        
        `@${finalUsername} Dáº¡ Ä‘áº¿n giá» há»c nhÆ°ng HS chÆ°a vĂ o nhá» anh/chá»‹ bĂ¡o PHHS áº¡`
      ].join("\n");

      await telegram.sendMessage(TARGET_GROUP_ID, text);
    }

    res.status(200).json({ success: true, count: students.length });
  } catch (error) {
    console.error("Lá»—i check attendance:", error);
    res.status(500).json({ error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : "Internal Server Error" });
  }
}


=== FILE: api\cron.ts ===
// Vercel Cron Function. Runs every minute (see vercel.json) and drip-sends a
// small batch of queued announcements to their target group, spacing the sends
// ~15s apart so the group is never flooded. The HTTP boundary only builds the
// real deps and enforces the cron auth guard; the testable work lives in the
// exported runCron() so tests can inject a fake sleep (no real 15s wait).
import { checkUnansweredMessages } from "../lib/monitor.js";
import type { VercelRequest, VercelResponse } from "@vercel/node";
import { loadConfig } from "../lib/config.js";
import {
  claimRow,
  countUnsent,
  fetchNextUnsent,
  getClient,
  releaseRow,
} from "../lib/supabase.js";
import { createTelegramClient, type TelegramClient } from "../lib/telegram.js";
import type { SupabaseClient } from "@supabase/supabase-js";

// How many queued messages one cron run sends, and how long to wait BETWEEN
// sends. 3 sends at 15s spacing = ~30s active time per run, safely under
// Vercel's serverless limit, giving an effective ~15-20s/message throughput on
// a per-minute cron. Named so they are easy to tune and overridable in tests.
export const CRON_BATCH_SIZE = 3;
export const CRON_DELAY_MS = 15000;

// Private completion DM sent once an admin's queue is fully drained.
const COMPLETION_MESSAGE = "âœ… ÄĂ£ gá»­i xong toĂ n bá»™ danh sĂ¡ch vĂ o nhĂ³m.";

// Real sleep used in production; tests inject their own fake sleep.
function defaultSleep(ms: number): Promise<void> {
  return new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, ms));
}

export interface CronDeps {
  telegram: TelegramClient;
  supabase: SupabaseClient;
  sleep?: (ms: number) => Promise<void>;
  batchSize?: number;
  delayMs?: number;
}

// Core drip-send logic. Fetches up to batchSize unsent rows and sends them one
// at a time (first immediately, then a delayMs wait before each subsequent
// send). A successful send is marked sent right away; a failed send is left
// unsent so the next cron run retries it. Each send+mark is isolated in its own
// try/catch so a single failure can never abort the loop. After the batch, any
// admin whose queue is now empty gets a one-time completion DM.
export async function runCron(deps: CronDeps): Promise<void> {
  const sleep = deps.sleep ?? defaultSleep;
  const batchSize = deps.batchSize ?? CRON_BATCH_SIZE;
  const delayMs = deps.delayMs ?? CRON_DELAY_MS;

  const { rows } = await fetchNextUnsent(deps.supabase, batchSize);
  
  if (rows.length === 0) {
    return; // empty queue: nothing to send
  }

  // Track which admins actually had a message sent THIS run, so the completion
  // DM is only considered for them (never fired by a run that sent nothing).
  const sentForAdmin = new Set<number>();
  let sentCount = 0;

  for (let i = 0; i < rows.length; i++) {
    const row = rows[i];
    try {
      // CLAIM first: atomically flip this row to sent. If another overlapping
      // cron run already claimed it, we lose the claim and skip (no double
      // send). This closes the read-then-send race that caused duplicates.
      const claim = await claimRow(deps.supabase, row.id);
      if (!claim.ok || !claim.claimed) {
        continue; // someone else owns this row; do not send it again
      }

      const result = await deps.telegram.sendMessage(
        row.chat_id,
        row.message_text
      );
      if (result.ok) {
        sentForAdmin.add(row.admin_id);
        sentCount++;
        // Space out ONLY real sends; skipped/claimed-away rows add no delay.
        if (i < rows.length - 1) {
          await sleep(delayMs);
        }
      } else {
        // Send failed after claiming -> release so the next run retries it.
        await releaseRow(deps.supabase, row.id);
      }
    } catch {
      // Any unexpected failure: try to release the row so it is retried, and
      // continue with the rest of the batch.
      try {
        await releaseRow(deps.supabase, row.id);
      } catch {
        // ignore
      }
    }
  }

  // Only consider completion when this run actually sent something, and only
  // for admins we sent for â€” so the "ÄĂ£ gá»­i xong" DM fires exactly once, when
  // the final message drains that admin's queue (not on empty/no-op runs).
  if (sentCount > 0) {
    for (const adminId of sentForAdmin) {
      try {
        const { count } = await countUnsent(deps.supabase, adminId);
        if (count === 0) {
          await deps.telegram.sendMessage(adminId, COMPLETION_MESSAGE);
        }
      } catch {
        // A completion-notice failure must not crash the cron.
      }
    }
  }
}

// Accepts the request only when it is a genuine Vercel cron invocation. Vercel
// attaches an `x-vercel-cron` header to its cron requests; when a CRON_SECRET
// env var is set, an `Authorization: Bearer <secret>` header is also accepted.
// Anything else is ignored (still 200, but no work) to avoid abuse.
function isAuthorizedCron(req: VercelRequest): boolean {
  if (req.headers["x-vercel-cron"] !== undefined) {
    return true;
  }
  const secret = process.env.CRON_SECRET;
  if (secret && req.headers["authorization"] === `Bearer ${secret}`) {
    return true;
  }
  return false;
}

export default async function handler(
  req: VercelRequest,
  res: VercelResponse
): Promise<void> {
  // Unauthorized callers get a 200 but trigger no sends.
  if (!isAuthorizedCron(req)) {
    res.status(200).json({ ok: true, skipped: true });
    return;
  }

  let config;
  try {
    config = loadConfig();
  } catch {
    // Even a config error returns 200 so the cron scheduler does not retry-storm.
    res.status(200).json({ ok: true, skipped: true });
    return;
  }

  const deps: CronDeps = {
    telegram: createTelegramClient(config.botToken),
    supabase: getClient(config.supabaseUrl, config.supabaseKey),
  };

  // Catch everything so a single failure never crashes the cron.
  try {
    await runCron(deps);
  } catch (err) {
    // Swallow: a failed send stays unsent and retries on the next run.
    console.error("Cron send error:", err);
  }

  // TIáº¾N TRĂŒNH QUĂ‰T SLA Äá»˜C Láº¬P HOĂ€N TOĂ€N (Äáº£m báº£o bĂªn trong monitor.ts cĂ³ query .eq("handled", false))
  try {
    await checkUnansweredMessages(deps.telegram, deps.supabase);
  } catch (err) {
    console.error("SLA Check error:", err);
  }

  res.status(200).json({ ok: true });
}

=== FILE: api\webhook.ts ===
// Vercel Serverless Function entry point. HTTP boundary only: parse the
// Telegram update, validate config, delegate to the handler, and reply to
// Telegram quickly.

import type { VercelRequest, VercelResponse } from "@vercel/node";
import { loadConfig } from "../lib/config.js";
import { handleUpdate, type Deps } from "../lib/handler.js";
import { getClient } from "../lib/supabase.js";
import { createTelegramClient } from "../lib/telegram.js";
import type { TelegramUpdate } from "../lib/types.js";

export default async function handler(
  req: VercelRequest,
  res: VercelResponse
): Promise<void> {
  // Validate env config first. A missing var is a hard config error (500) and
  // is the ONLY non-200 outcome.
  let config;
  try {
    config = loadConfig();
  } catch (err) {
    res.status(500).json({
      error: err instanceof Error ? err.message : "configuration error",
    });
    return;
  }

  const update = parseUpdate(req.body);

  const deps: Deps = {
    telegram: createTelegramClient(config.botToken),
    supabase: getClient(config.supabaseUrl, config.supabaseKey),
    relayEnabled: config.relayEnabled,
  };

  // Always return HTTP 200 for handled message-processing outcomes so Telegram
  // does not re-deliver the same update and cause a retry storm.
  try {
    await handleUpdate(update, deps);
  } catch {
    // Swallow handled-flow errors; still acknowledge to Telegram with 200.
  }

  res.status(200).json({ ok: true });
}

function parseUpdate(body: unknown): TelegramUpdate {
  if (typeof body === "string") {
    try {
      return JSON.parse(body) as TelegramUpdate;
    } catch {
      return { update_id: 0 };
    }
  }
  if (body && typeof body === "object") {
    return body as TelegramUpdate;
  }
  return { update_id: 0 };
}



=== FILE: lib\batch.ts ===
// Pure batch-announcement parsing and formatting. Reads an .xlsx buffer into
// typed rows, builds the fixed group announcement form, and builds the private
// summary report. No Telegram/Supabase I/O lives here (that is the handler's
// job), so every function is directly unit-testable.

import * as XLSX from "xlsx";
import type { BatchRow, MappedItem } from "./types.js";

// Default closing line used when the admin did not supply a custom one via the
// file caption.
export const DEFAULT_CLOSING =
  "HS nay cĂ³ ca há»c QLL náº¯m thĂªm thĂ´ng tin trao Ä‘á»•i vá»›i PHHS lá»‹ch ná»¯a nhĂ© áº¡ !";

// Canonical header labels (trimmed, lowercased) for the five known columns.
const HEADER_TEN = "tĂªn";
const HEADER_MA_LOP = "mĂ£ lá»›p";
const HEADER_NGAY_HOC = "ngĂ y há»c";
const HEADER_QLL = "qll";
const HEADER_LICH_HOC = "lá»‹ch há»c";

function headerKey(cell: unknown): string {
  return String(cell ?? "").trim().toLowerCase();
}

function cellText(cell: unknown): string {
  return String(cell ?? "").trim();
}

// parseSheet(buf): read the FIRST worksheet of the workbook, resolve the five
// columns by trimmed/case-insensitive header match (robust to a trailing space
// like "TĂªn " and to extra/unknown columns), and return one BatchRow per data
// row. Rows whose QLL cell is blank are skipped (no name to map). lichHoc may
// be "".
export function parseSheet(buf: Buffer): BatchRow[] {
  const workbook = XLSX.read(buf, { type: "buffer" });
  const sheetName = workbook.SheetNames[0];
  if (!sheetName) {
    return [];
  }
  const sheet = workbook.Sheets[sheetName];
  const grid = XLSX.utils.sheet_to_json<unknown[]>(sheet, {
    header: 1,
    raw: false,
    defval: "",
  });
  if (grid.length === 0) {
    return [];
  }

  // Find the REAL header row: some exports prepend junk rows (e.g. repeated
  // "Column1".."Column5" placeholders) before the actual "TĂªn / MĂ£ lá»›p / NgĂ y
  // há»c / QLL / Lá»‹ch há»c" header. Scan for the first row that contains both the
  // "tĂªn" and "qll" header labels, and treat that as the header row.
  let headerRow = -1;
  for (let r = 0; r < grid.length; r++) {
    const keys = grid[r].map(headerKey);
    if (keys.includes(HEADER_TEN) && keys.includes(HEADER_QLL)) {
      headerRow = r;
      break;
    }
  }
  if (headerRow === -1) {
    return []; // no recognizable header -> nothing to parse
  }

  const header = grid[headerRow];
  const idx: Record<string, number> = {};
  header.forEach((cell, i) => {
    idx[headerKey(cell)] = i;
  });

  const colTen = idx[HEADER_TEN];
  const colMaLop = idx[HEADER_MA_LOP];
  const colNgayHoc = idx[HEADER_NGAY_HOC];
  const colQll = idx[HEADER_QLL];
  const colLichHoc = idx[HEADER_LICH_HOC];

  const at = (row: unknown[], col: number | undefined): string =>
    col === undefined ? "" : cellText(row[col]);

  const rows: BatchRow[] = [];
  for (let r = headerRow + 1; r < grid.length; r++) {
    const row = grid[r];
    const qll = at(row, colQll);
    if (qll === "") {
      continue; // no QLL name -> nothing to map
    }
    rows.push({
      tenHS: at(row, colTen),
      maLop: at(row, colMaLop),
      ngayHoc: at(row, colNgayHoc),
      qll,
      lichHoc: at(row, colLichHoc),
    });
  }
  return rows;
}

// subjectHashtag(maLop): the subject hashtag derived from the first 4 chars of
// the class code (e.g. "TOAN.2026.1176" -> "#TOAN", "MOET_TH.2025.0104" ->
// "#MOET", "KHTN.2026.0746" -> "#KHTN"). Returns "" when the code is too short
// or has no usable leading letters/digits, so no stray "#" is added.
export function subjectHashtag(maLop: string): string {
  // Take the leading run of letters/digits, then its first 4 chars uppercased.
  const head = maLop.trim().replace(/[^A-Za-z0-9].*$/, "").slice(0, 4).toUpperCase();
  return head === "" ? "" : `#${head}`;
}

// buildAnnouncement(item): the exact group message form. The whole "Lá»‹ch há»c"
// line is omitted (no leftover blank line) when lichHoc is blank. The subject
// hashtag (from the first 4 chars of the class code) is appended to the title
// line, e.g. "âœ… ThĂ´ng tin há»c cá»§a con #TOAN".
export function buildAnnouncement(item: MappedItem): string {
  const hashtag = subjectHashtag(item.maLop);
  const title =
    hashtag === ""
      ? "âœ… ThĂ´ng tin há»c cá»§a con"
      : `âœ… ThĂ´ng tin há»c cá»§a con ${hashtag}`;
  const lines = [
    title,
    `Há»c sinh: ${item.tenHS}`,
    `MĂ£ lá»›p há»c: ${item.maLop}`,
  ];
  if (item.lichHoc !== "") {
    lines.push(`Lá»‹ch há»c: ${item.lichHoc}`);
  }
  lines.push(`NgĂ y há»c: ${item.ngayHoc}`);
  lines.push("");
  // Use the admin's custom closing line (from caption) when present and
  // non-empty; otherwise fall back to the default. The @username tag is always
  // appended at the end.
  const closing =
    item.cauNhan && item.cauNhan.trim() !== ""
      ? item.cauNhan.trim()
      : DEFAULT_CLOSING;
  lines.push(`${closing} @${item.username}`);
  return lines.join("\n");
}

// groupByUsername(items): buckets mapped items by their QLL username into an
// insertion-ordered Map, preserving the first-seen order of usernames AND the
// first-seen order of students within each bucket. Used by /ok to combine all
// students sharing one QLL into a single tagged announcement.
export function groupByUsername(
  items: MappedItem[]
): Map<string, MappedItem[]> {
  // Group key = username + subject hashtag. One QLL who handles students in two
  // DIFFERENT subjects gets ONE message PER SUBJECT (a QLL never owns two
  // subjects in a single message), while same-QLL-same-subject students are
  // combined. The subject comes from the class code's first 4 chars.
  const groups = new Map<string, MappedItem[]>();
  for (const item of items) {
    const subject = subjectHashtag(item.maLop); // "#KHTN" etc, "" if none
    const key = `${item.username}\u0000${subject}`;
    const bucket = groups.get(key);
    if (bucket) {
      bucket.push(item);
    } else {
      groups.set(key, [item]);
    }
  }
  return groups;
}

// buildGroupedAnnouncement(username, students, cauNhan): combines every student
// sharing ONE QLL into a single announcement that tags that QLL exactly once.
// The title lists the DISTINCT subject hashtags across the group's students
// (first-seen order, space-separated); the hashtag part is omitted entirely
// when none is derivable. Each student is a "â€¢" bullet carrying its own MĂ£ lá»›p,
// Lá»‹ch há»c (omitted when blank), and NgĂ y há»c. The closing line (cauNhan when
// provided and non-blank, else DEFAULT_CLOSING) ends with " @<username>".
export function buildGroupedAnnouncement(
  username: string,
  students: MappedItem[],
  cauNhan?: string
): string {
  // Distinct subject hashtags, first-seen order, blanks dropped.
  const hashtags: string[] = [];
  for (const s of students) {
    const tag = subjectHashtag(s.maLop);
    if (tag !== "" && !hashtags.includes(tag)) {
      hashtags.push(tag);
    }
  }

  const title =
    hashtags.length === 0
      ? "âœ… ThĂ´ng tin há»c cá»§a con"
      : `âœ… ThĂ´ng tin há»c cá»§a con ${hashtags.join(" ")}`;

  // De-duplicate identical rows: the source sheet can repeat the exact same
  // (HS + mĂ£ lá»›p + lá»‹ch + ngĂ y) line, which would otherwise show as duplicate
  // bullets. Two DIFFERENT subjects/classes for the same student are kept (the
  // key includes maLop), so a student with two classes still lists both.
  const seen = new Set<string>();
  const uniqueStudents: MappedItem[] = [];
  for (const s of students) {
    const key = `${s.tenHS}|${s.maLop}|${s.lichHoc}|${s.ngayHoc}`;
    if (!seen.has(key)) {
      seen.add(key);
      uniqueStudents.push(s);
    }
  }

  const lines = [title, ""];
  uniqueStudents.forEach((s, i) => {
    lines.push(`${i + 1}. ${s.tenHS}`);
    lines.push(`   â€¢ MĂ£ lá»›p: ${s.maLop}`);
    if (s.lichHoc !== "") {
      lines.push(`   â€¢ Lá»‹ch há»c: ${s.lichHoc}`);
    }
    lines.push(`   â€¢ NgĂ y há»c: ${s.ngayHoc}`);
    lines.push("");
  });

  const closing =
    cauNhan && cauNhan.trim() !== "" ? cauNhan.trim() : DEFAULT_CLOSING;
  lines.push(`${closing} @${username}`);
  return lines.join("\n");
}

// buildSummary(total, mapped, unmapped): the private report the admin sees
// before confirming. Lists the mapped students ("TĂªn HS -> @username") and the
// unmapped QLL names, and ends with the fixed confirmation instruction.
export function buildSummary(
  total: number,
  mapped: { tenHS: string; username: string }[],
  unmapped: string[]
): string {
  const lines: string[] = [];
  lines.push(`Tá»•ng sá»‘ dĂ²ng: ${total}`);

  lines.push(`ÄĂ£ map (${mapped.length}):`);
  if (mapped.length === 0) {
    lines.push("(khĂ´ng cĂ³)");
  } else {
    for (const m of mapped) {
      lines.push(`- ${m.tenHS} -> @${m.username}`);
    }
  }

  lines.push(`KhĂ´ng tĂ¬m tháº¥y (${unmapped.length}):`);
  if (unmapped.length === 0) {
    lines.push("(khĂ´ng cĂ³)");
  } else {
    for (const name of unmapped) {
      lines.push(`- ${name}`);
    }
  }

  lines.push("");
  lines.push("GĂµ /ok Ä‘á»ƒ gá»­i, /huy Ä‘á»ƒ huá»·.");
  return lines.join("\n");
}

// Reads and validates the required environment variables.

export interface Config {
  botToken: string;
  supabaseUrl: string;
  supabaseKey: string;
  // Master switch for the credential relay flow (delete + inbox + reply).
  // Defaults to FALSE so the bot never mutates the group unless RELAY_ENABLED
  // is explicitly set to "true". While false the bot only passively collects
  // users into telegram_users_qll.
  relayEnabled: boolean;
}

// Throws an Error naming the FIRST missing/empty variable.
export function loadConfig(): Config {
  const botToken = process.env.BOT_TOKEN;
  if (!botToken) {
    throw new Error("Missing required environment variable: BOT_TOKEN");
  }

  const supabaseUrl = process.env.SUPABASE_URL;
  if (!supabaseUrl) {
    throw new Error("Missing required environment variable: SUPABASE_URL");
  }

  const supabaseKey = process.env.SUPABASE_KEY;
  if (!supabaseKey) {
    throw new Error("Missing required environment variable: SUPABASE_KEY");
  }

  // Relay is OFF unless RELAY_ENABLED is exactly "true" (case-insensitive,
  // trimmed). Any other value â€” including unset â€” keeps the relay disabled.
  const relayEnabled =
    (process.env.RELAY_ENABLED ?? "").trim().toLowerCase() === "true";

  return { botToken, supabaseUrl, supabaseKey, relayEnabled };
}



=== FILE: lib\detector.ts ===
// Sensitive-content detection for Telegram reply text.

// Normalize for comparison: NFD, strip combining marks (diacritics), lowercase.
function normalize(text: string): string {
  return text
    .normalize("NFD")
    .replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g, "")
    .toLowerCase();
}

// Returns true when the text contains a TK/MK keyword (case- and
// diacritic-insensitive, with colon variants) OR, after removing spaces,
// dashes, and dots, a continuous run of 8 or more digits.
export function isSensitive(text: string): boolean {
  const normalized = normalize(text);

  // Word-boundary-aware short tokens tk / mk (with optional colon/space),
  // so arbitrary words that merely contain those letters are not matched.
  if (/\b(tk|mk)\b/.test(normalized)) {
    return true;
  }

  // Full-phrase keywords (diacritics already stripped).
  if (normalized.includes("tai khoan") || normalized.includes("mat khau")) {
    return true;
  }

  // Numeric rule: strip spaces/dashes/dots, then look for 8+ digits in a row.
  const compact = text.replace(/[\s.\-]/g, "");
  if (/\d{8,}/.test(compact)) {
    return true;
  }

  return false;
}

// (the message.from on a join event is whoever added them / the joiner).
async function collectUsers(
  message: TelegramMessage,
  deps: Deps
): Promise<void> {
  const chat = message.chat;
  if (chat.type !== "group" && chat.type !== "supergroup") {
    return;
  }

  // De-duplicate within this single update by telegram_id.
  const seen = new Map<number, TelegramUser>();

  if (message.from && !isBot(message.from)) {
    seen.set(message.from.id, message.from);
  }
  for (const member of message.new_chat_members ?? []) {
    if (!isBot(member)) {
      seen.set(member.id, member);
    }
  }

  for (const user of seen.values()) {
    await upsertUser(deps.supabase, buildUserRecord(user, chat));
  }
}

function isBot(user: TelegramUser): boolean {
  return user.is_bot === true;
}

// Marker that identifies one of the bot's HS announcements (grouped or single).
const ANNOUNCEMENT_MARKER = "âœ… ThĂ´ng tin há»c cá»§a con";
// The ack the bot posts when a QLL replies to an announcement.
const ACK_REPLY = "Dáº¡ em ghi nháº­n chuyá»ƒn anh/chá»‹ bĂªn em kiá»ƒm tra nha áº¡.";

// If a group message is a REPLY to one of the bot's HS announcements, post a
// short acknowledgement as a reply to the replier. Returns true when handled.
// Independent of the relay switch. We require the replied-to message to be
// authored by a bot AND to contain the announcement marker, so ordinary chat
// and replies to other messages are never answered.
async function maybeAckAnnouncementReply(
  message: TelegramMessage,
  deps: Deps
): Promise<boolean> {
  const chat = message.chat;
  if (chat.type !== "group" && chat.type !== "supergroup") {
    return false;
  }
  const repliedTo = message.reply_to_message;
  if (!repliedTo) {
    return false;
  }
  const repliedIsBotAnnouncement =
    repliedTo.from?.is_bot === true &&
    (repliedTo.text ?? "").includes(ANNOUNCEMENT_MARKER);
  if (!repliedIsBotAnnouncement) {
    return false;
  }
  // Don't answer the bot replying to itself.
  if (message.from?.is_bot === true) {
    return true;
  }
  // 1) Public ack to the QLL in the group.
  await deps.telegram.sendMessage(chat.id, ACK_REPLY, message.message_id);

  // 2) Private notice to every admin so they can follow up. Includes who
  // replied, what they said, and a short excerpt of the announcement they
  // replied to (so the admin knows which HS/QLL it concerns).
  const who = message.from ? displayName(message.from) : "QLL";
  const uname = message.from?.username ? ` (@${message.from.username})` : "";
  const said = (message.text ?? "").trim() || "(khĂ´ng cĂ³ ná»™i dung)";
  const excerptSource = (repliedTo.text ?? "").split("\n").slice(0, 2).join(" ").trim();
  const excerpt =
    excerptSource.length > 160
      ? `${excerptSource.slice(0, 160)}â€¦`
      : excerptSource;
  const notice = [
    "đŸ”” QLL pháº£n há»“i thĂ´ng bĂ¡o:",
    `đŸ‘¤ ${who}${uname}`,
    `đŸ’¬ ${said}`,
    `đŸ“‹ ${excerpt}`,
  ].join("\n");
  for (const adminId of SPAMTEST_ADMIN_IDS) {
    await deps.telegram.sendMessage(adminId, notice);
  }
  return true;
}

// Handles the operator-only /spam command issued from the bot's PRIVATE chat.
// Returns true if the update WAS a /spam attempt (so the caller stops further
// processing), false otherwise. Only an allow-listed admin in a private chat
// may trigger it; anyone/anywhere else is a silent no-op. On success it posts
// exactly ONE announcement into the fixed target group and sends the operator
// a short confirmation in their private chat.
async function maybeHandleSpamTest(
  message: TelegramMessage,
  deps: Deps
): Promise<boolean> {
  const text = message.text?.trim() ?? "";
  if (text !== SPAMTEST_COMMAND) {
    return false;
  }
  // Must be a PRIVATE chat with an allow-listed operator.
  const fromId = message.from?.id;
  const authorized =
    message.chat.type === "private" &&
    fromId !== undefined &&
    SPAMTEST_ADMIN_IDS.includes(fromId);
  if (!authorized) {
    return true; // swallow: not authorized / wrong chat, post nothing
  }
  // Post exactly one announcement into the fixed target group.
  await deps.telegram.sendMessage(SPAMTEST_TARGET_CHAT_ID, SPAMTEST_MESSAGE);
  // Confirm back to the operator privately.
  await deps.telegram.sendMessage(
    message.chat.id,
    "âœ… ÄĂ£ gá»­i thĂ´ng bĂ¡o vĂ o nhĂ³m."
  );
  return true;
}

// True only for a private-chat message sent by an allow-listed operator.
function isAdminPrivate(message: TelegramMessage): boolean {
  const fromId = message.from?.id;
  return (
    message.chat.type === "private" &&
    fromId !== undefined &&
    SPAMTEST_ADMIN_IDS.includes(fromId)
  );
}

// Batch-announcement dispatcher. Only an admin in a private chat is served;
// everyone/everywhere else returns false so normal processing continues (and
// group documents still get passively collected upstream). Returns true when
// this handler OWNED the update. All downstream errors are caught and reported
// privately â€” the function never throws, so the webhook always returns 200.
//
// Three owned cases:
//   1. a document (any caption that is not /ok): download + parse + map, save
//      the ready-to-send items to pending_batches, reply with a summary. Posts
//      NOTHING to the group.
//   2. /ok: load the pending batch and enqueue one send_queue row per mapped
//      item (fully-formatted announcement text), delete the pending row, and
//      confirm. Posts NOTHING to the group synchronously â€” the Vercel cron
//      (api/cron.ts) drip-sends the queued rows ~15-20s apart.
//   3. /huy: delete the pending row and confirm.
// Manual QLL-management commands, admin-private only (the caller already gated
// on isAdminPrivate). Returns true when the message WAS one of /adduser,
// /finduser, /listusers (so the batch dispatcher stops), false otherwise. Every
// reply goes privately to message.chat.id; nothing is posted to the group.
async function maybeHandleQllCommands(
  message: TelegramMessage,
  deps: Deps,
  text: string
): Promise<boolean> {
  const lower = text.toLowerCase();

  // /adduser <username> <full name...>
  if (lower.startsWith(ADD_USER_COMMAND)) {
    const rest = text.slice(ADD_USER_COMMAND.length).trim();
    const match = rest.match(/^(\S+)\s+(.+)$/);
    if (!match) {
      await deps.telegram.sendMessage(
        message.chat.id,
        "CĂº phĂ¡p: /adduser @username Há» TĂªn"
      );
      return true;
    }
    const username = match[1].replace(/^@/, "");
    const fullName = match[2].trim();
    if (username === "" || fullName === "") {
      await deps.telegram.sendMessage(
        message.chat.id,
        "CĂº phĂ¡p: /adduser @username Há» TĂªn"
      );
      return true;
    }
    // One username = one QLL row. If the username already exists (added
    // manually OR auto-collected), UPDATE its registered full name to the new
    // one (so mapping-by-full-name works for the sheet's name); otherwise add a
    // fresh row. Either way there is never a duplicate row for a username.
    const existing = await findUserByUsername(deps.supabase, username);
    await addUserManual(
      deps.supabase,
      username,
      fullName,
      SPAMTEST_TARGET_CHAT_ID
    );
    await deps.telegram.sendMessage(
      message.chat.id,
      existing.exists
        ? `â™»ï¸ ÄĂ£ cáº­p nháº­t tĂªn QLL: @${username} -> ${fullName}.`
        : `âœ… ÄĂ£ thĂªm QLL: @${username} (${fullName}).`
    );
    return true;
  }

  // /finduser <full name...>
  if (lower.startsWith(FIND_USER_COMMAND)) {
    const name = text.slice(FIND_USER_COMMAND.length).trim();
    if (name === "") {
      await deps.telegram.sendMessage(
        message.chat.id,
        "CĂº phĂ¡p: /finduser Há» TĂªn"
      );
      return true;
    }
    const { users } = await listKnownUsers(deps.supabase);
    const result = mapQllByUser(name, users);
    if (result.kind === "found") {
      await deps.telegram.sendMessage(
        message.chat.id,
        `đŸ” ${name} -> @${result.username}`
      );
    } else if (result.kind === "ambiguous") {
      await deps.telegram.sendMessage(
        message.chat.id,
        `â ï¸ CĂ³ nhiá»u username khá»›p cho: ${name}`
      );
    } else {
      await deps.telegram.sendMessage(
        message.chat.id,
        `âŒ KhĂ´ng tĂ¬m tháº¥y username cho: ${name}`
      );
    }
    return true;
  }

  // /listusers
  if (lower.startsWith(LIST_USERS_COMMAND)) {
    const { usernames } = await listUsernames(deps.supabase);
    const total = usernames.length;
    const preview = usernames.slice(0, LIST_USERS_PREVIEW_CAP);
    const tagged = preview.map((u) => `@${u}`).join(", ");
    const suffix = total > LIST_USERS_PREVIEW_CAP ? ", â€¦" : "";
    await deps.telegram.sendMessage(
      message.chat.id,
      `đŸ“‹ Äang cĂ³ ${total} QLL: ${tagged}${suffix}`
    );
    return true;
  }

  return false;
}

async function maybeHandleBatch(
  message: TelegramMessage,
  deps: Deps
): Promise<boolean> {
  if (!isAdminPrivate(message)) {
    return false;
  }
  const adminId = message.from!.id;
  const text = message.text?.trim() ?? "";

  // 0. Nháº­n cĂ¡c lá»‡nh quáº£n lĂ½ ca trá»±c (/dp, /Ä‘p) vĂ  CTV váº­n hĂ nh (/addctv, /delctv)
  if (
    await maybeHandleCoordinatorCommands(
      message,
      deps.telegram,
      deps.supabase,
      text
    )
  ) {
    return true;
  }

  // Bá»• sung: Lá»‡nh /tatsla Ä‘á»ƒ táº¡m dá»«ng/táº¯t cháº¿ Ä‘á»™ giĂ¡m sĂ¡t SLA 5 phĂºt
  if (text.toLowerCase().startsWith('/tatsla')) {
    await updateConfig(deps.supabase, { slaEnabled: false });
    await deps.telegram.sendMessage(message.chat.id, "đŸ”´ ÄĂ£ Táº®T cháº¿ Ä‘á»™ giĂ¡m sĂ¡t SLA 5 phĂºt.");
    return true;
  }

  // Bá»• sung: Lá»‡nh /batsla Ä‘á»ƒ báº­t láº¡i cháº¿ Ä‘á»™ giĂ¡m sĂ¡t SLA 5 phĂºt
  if (text.toLowerCase().startsWith('/batsla')) {
    await updateConfig(deps.supabase, { slaEnabled: true });
    await deps.telegram.sendMessage(message.chat.id, "đŸŸ¢ ÄĂ£ Báº¬T láº¡i cháº¿ Ä‘á»™ giĂ¡m sĂ¡t SLA 5 phĂºt.");
    return true;
  }

  // Case 0.5: Import hĂ ng loáº¡t CTV qua file Excel kĂ¨m caption /addctv
  if (message.document && message.caption?.trim().toLowerCase().startsWith('/addctv')) {
    const download = await deps.telegram.downloadFile(message.document.file_id);
    if (!download.ok) {
      await deps.telegram.sendMessage(
        message.chat.id,
        "KhĂ´ng táº£i Ä‘Æ°á»£c file danh sĂ¡ch CTV. Thá»­ gá»­i láº¡i nhĂ©."
      );
      return true;
    }

    let rows;
    try {
      rows = parseSheet(download.buffer);
    } catch {
      await deps.telegram.sendMessage(
        message.chat.id,
        "KhĂ´ng Ä‘á»c Ä‘Æ°á»£c file Excel CTV. Kiá»ƒm tra láº¡i Ä‘á»‹nh dáº¡ng .xlsx."
      );
      return true;
    }

    const newCtvUsernames: string[] = [];
    for (const row of rows) {
      const uname = (row.qll || "").replace(/^@/, "").trim().toLowerCase();
      if (uname) {
        newCtvUsernames.push(uname);
      }
    }

    await updateConfig(deps.supabase, { ctvUsernames: newCtvUsernames });

    await deps.telegram.sendMessage(
      message.chat.id,
      `âœ… ÄĂ£ cáº­p nháº­t thĂ nh cĂ´ng ${newCtvUsernames.length} tĂ i khoáº£n CTV vĂ o danh sĂ¡ch miá»…n trá»« SLA!`
    );
    return true;
  }

  // Manual QLL-management commands come FIRST so they can never be mis-eaten by
  // the document / /ok / /huy branches. None of them share a prefix with /ok,
  // /huy, or /spam, so ordering them first is safe.
  if (await maybeHandleQllCommands(message, deps, text)) {
    return true;
  }

  // Case 1: a document upload (unless the caption is exactly /ok, which we let
  // the /ok text path own â€” in practice /ok arrives as text, not a caption).
  if (message.document && message.caption?.trim() !== BATCH_OK_COMMAND) {
    const download = await deps.telegram.downloadFile(message.document.file_id);
    if (!download.ok) {
      await deps.telegram.sendMessage(
        message.chat.id,
        "KhĂ´ng táº£i Ä‘Æ°á»£c file. Thá»­ gá»­i láº¡i nhĂ©."
      );
      return true;
    }

    let rows;
    try {
      rows = parseSheet(download.buffer);
    } catch {
      await deps.telegram.sendMessage(
        message.chat.id,
        "KhĂ´ng Ä‘á»c Ä‘Æ°á»£c file Excel. Kiá»ƒm tra láº¡i Ä‘á»‹nh dáº¡ng .xlsx."
      );
      return true;
    }

    const { users: knownUsers } = await listKnownUsers(deps.supabase);

    // The file caption (if any) becomes the custom closing line for this batch.
    // An empty caption means "use the default closing line".
    const cauNhan = message.caption?.trim() ?? "";

    const items: MappedItem[] = [];
    const mappedSummary: { tenHS: string; username: string }[] = [];
    const unmapped: string[] = [];

    for (const row of rows) {
      const match = mapQllByUser(row.qll, knownUsers);
      if (match.kind === "found") {
        items.push({
          tenHS: row.tenHS,
          maLop: row.maLop,
          ngayHoc: row.ngayHoc,
          lichHoc: row.lichHoc,
          username: match.username,
          cauNhan: cauNhan === "" ? undefined : cauNhan,
        });
        mappedSummary.push({ tenHS: row.tenHS, username: match.username });
      } else {
        unmapped.push(row.qll);
      }
    }

    await savePendingBatch(deps.supabase, adminId, items);
    await deps.telegram.sendMessage(
      message.chat.id,
      buildSummary(rows.length, mappedSummary, unmapped)
    );
    return true;
  }

  // Case 2: /ok [HH:MM | dd/mm HH:MM] -> enqueue the pending batch for slow
  // drip-sending by the cron. A bare /ok sends immediately (send_after=null); a
  // time/date-time schedules the batch (send_after=ISO on every row). Matched
  // by prefix so the optional time argument is recognised; /huy never starts
  // with /ok so it is unaffected.
  if (text.toLowerCase().startsWith(BATCH_OK_COMMAND)) {
    const parsed = parseOkCommand(text);
    if (parsed.kind === "invalid") {
      await deps.telegram.sendMessage(message.chat.id, parsed.reason);
      return true;
    }

    const pending = await loadPendingBatch(deps.supabase, adminId);
    const items = pending.items ?? [];
    if (!pending.ok || items.length === 0) {
      await deps.telegram.sendMessage(
        message.chat.id,
        "KhĂ´ng cĂ³ danh sĂ¡ch nĂ o Ä‘ang chá»."
      );
      return true;
    }

    const sendAfter = parsed.kind === "at" ? parsed.sendAfterIso : null;

    // Group all students sharing a QLL into ONE announcement per QLL so each
    // QLL is tagged exactly once. Store the fully-formatted text (incl. the
    // @username tag) so the cron sends message_text verbatim. send_after is
    // null for immediate sends and the scheduled ISO for a háº¹n-giá» batch.
    // One message per (QLL + subject): same QLL + same subject is combined; a
    // QLL with students in two subjects gets one message per subject (a QLL is
    // never tagged for two subjects in one message). The username is taken from
    // the bucket's items, not the composite key.
    const groups = groupByUsername(items);
    const rows = Array.from(groups.values()).map((students) => ({
      admin_id: adminId,
      chat_id: SPAMTEST_TARGET_CHAT_ID,
      message_text: buildGroupedAnnouncement(
        students[0].username,
        students,
        students[0]?.cauNhan
      ),
      send_after: sendAfter,
    }));
    await enqueueMessages(deps.supabase, rows);
    await deletePendingBatch(deps.supabase, adminId);

    const msgCount = groups.size;
    const confirmation =
      parsed.kind === "at"
        ? `âœ… ÄĂ£ lĂªn lá»‹ch gá»­i ${msgCount} tin lĂºc ${formatVnDateTime(
            parsed.sendAfterIso
          )} (giá» VN). Bot sáº½ tá»± gá»­i khi tá»›i giá».`
        : `âœ… ÄĂ£ xáº¿p ${msgCount} tin vĂ o hĂ ng Ä‘á»£i. Bot sáº½ gá»­i ráº£i ~15-20s/tin, sáº½ bĂ¡o láº¡i khi xong.`;
    await deps.telegram.sendMessage(message.chat.id, confirmation);
    return true;
  }

  // Case 3: /huy -> drop the pending batch.
  if (text === BATCH_CANCEL_COMMAND) {
    await deletePendingBatch(deps.supabase, adminId);
    await deps.telegram.sendMessage(
      message.chat.id,
      "ÄĂ£ huá»· danh sĂ¡ch Ä‘ang chá»."
    );
    return true;
  }

  // Case 4: /cancel -> stop a scheduled (háº¹n giá») batch AND an in-progress
  // drip by deleting every not-yet-sent row for this admin from send_queue.
  // Already-sent messages are not affected. Also clears any pending draft.
  if (text.toLowerCase() === BATCH_STOP_COMMAND) {
    await deletePendingBatch(deps.supabase, adminId);
    const res = await deleteUnsent(deps.supabase, adminId);
    await deps.telegram.sendMessage(
      message.chat.id,
      res.ok
        ? `đŸ›‘ ÄĂ£ huá»· ${res.count} tin chÆ°a gá»­i trong hĂ ng Ä‘á»£i (gá»“m cáº£ tin Ä‘Ă£ háº¹n giá»). CĂ¡c tin Ä‘Ă£ gá»­i khĂ´ng bá»‹ áº£nh hÆ°á»Ÿng.`
        : "KhĂ´ng huá»· Ä‘Æ°á»£c hĂ ng Ä‘á»£i, thá»­ láº¡i sau nhĂ©."
    );
    return true;
  }

  // Anything else from the admin private chat (e.g. /start) is not ours.
  return false;
}

async function relay(
  message: TelegramMessage,
  replyTo: TelegramMessage,
  deps: Deps
): Promise<void> {
  const groupChatId = message.chat.id;
  const replyMessageId = message.message_id;
  const sensitiveText = message.text ?? "";
  const inboxText = buildInboxText(replyTo.text ?? "", sensitiveText);
  const ctvName = message.from ? displayName(message.from) : "";
  const qllId = replyTo.from?.id;

  // Step 1: deliver to the QLL inbox FIRST, with a 10s timeout.
  let sendResult:
    | { ok: true; messageId: number }
    | { ok: false; forbidden: boolean; description: string };
  let timedOut = false;

  try {
    sendResult = await withTimeout(
      deps.telegram.sendMessage(qllId as number, inboxText),
      SEND_TIMEOUT_MS
    );
  } catch (error) {
    if (error instanceof TimeoutError) {
      // No response within 10s (Requirement 4.5) -> treat identically to 403.
      timedOut = true;
      sendResult = { ok: false, forbidden: false, description: "timeout" };
    } else {
      // Any other transport rejection is a non-403 delivery failure
      // (Requirement 2.3): retain the reply, do NOT take the destructive path.
      sendResult = {
        ok: false,
        forbidden: false,
        description: error instanceof Error ? error.message : "send error",
      };
    }
  }

  // Security path: 403 Forbidden OR 10s timeout â€” delete FIRST, then warn.
  if (timedOut || (!sendResult.ok && sendResult.forbidden)) {
    const deleteResult = await deleteWithRetry(
      deps.telegram,
      groupChatId,
      replyMessageId
    );

    if (deleteResult.ok) {
      await insertLog(
        deps.supabase,
        buildLogRecord(message, "Lá»—i chÆ°a start bot")
      );
      await deps.telegram.sendMessage(
        groupChatId,
        WARNING_NOT_STARTED,
        replyTo.message_id
      );
    } else {
      // Deletes failed; log the delete failure. The warning stays pending
      // until the reply is confirmed deleted.
      await insertLog(
        deps.supabase,
        buildLogRecord(message, STATUS_DELETION_FAILURE)
      );
    }
    return;
  }

  // Non-403 delivery failure: retain the reply, do NOT delete.
  if (!sendResult.ok) {
    await insertLog(
      deps.supabase,
      buildLogRecord(message, STATUS_DELIVERY_FAILURE)
    );
    return;
  }

  // Success path: delete the group reply, then log and confirm.
  const deleteResult = await deleteWithRetry(
    deps.telegram,
    groupChatId,
    replyMessageId
  );

  if (deleteResult.ok) {
    await insertLog(deps.supabase, buildLogRecord(message, "ÄĂ£ gá»­i Inbox"));
    await deps.telegram.sendMessage(
      groupChatId,
      confirmationLine(ctvName),
      replyTo.message_id
    );
  } else {
    // Delivered to inbox but all 3 delete retries failed.
    await insertLog(
      deps.supabase,
      buildLogRecord(message, STATUS_DELETION_FAILURE)
    );
  }
}

function getCurrentShift(): string {
  const vnTime = new Date(new Date().getTime() + 7 * 60 * 60 * 1000);
  const hour = vnTime.getUTCHours();
  const minute = vnTime.getUTCMinutes();
  const time = hour + minute / 60;

  if (time >= 8 && time <= 12) return "SĂ¡ng";
  if (time >= 13.5 && time <= 17) return "Chiá»u";
  if (time >= 17.5 && time <= 21.5) return "Tá»‘i";
  return "NgoĂ i ca";
}

function isQllCase(text: string): boolean {
  const hasNumber = /\d{3,}/.test(text); 
  const hasClassCode = /(TOAN|MOET|KHTN|TCLC|TA|TVTTH)/i.test(text); 
  return hasNumber || hasClassCode;
}

// Display-name and LogRecord field-mapping helpers.

import type {
  LogRecord,
  TelegramChat,
  TelegramMessage,
  TelegramUser,
  UserRecord,
} from "./types.js";

// first + " " + last when last present, else first, else username, else "".
export function displayName(user: TelegramUser): string {
  const parts = [user.first_name, user.last_name].filter(Boolean);
  if (parts.length > 0) {
    return parts.join(" ");
  }
  return user.username ?? "";
}

// Builds a telegram_users_qll row from a seen user and the chat they were seen
// in. username is null when the user has not set one; full_name uses the same
// first/last/username fallback as displayName.
export function buildUserRecord(
  user: TelegramUser,
  chat: TelegramChat
): UserRecord {
  return {
    telegram_id: user.id,
    username: user.username ?? null,
    full_name: displayName(user),
    chat_id: chat.id,
    chat_title: chat.title ?? null,
  };
}

// Derives a LogRecord from the sensitive reply (`message`) and the request it
// replies to (`message.reply_to_message`). The replied-to author is the QLL;
// the reply author is the CTV.
export function buildLogRecord(
  message: TelegramMessage,
  status: LogRecord["status"]
): LogRecord {
  const replyTo = message.reply_to_message;

  const createdAt = replyTo
    ? new Date(replyTo.date * 1000).toISOString()
    : new Date(message.date * 1000).toISOString();

  const qllUser = replyTo?.from;
  const ctvUser = message.from;

  return {
    created_at: createdAt,
    qll_telegram_id: qllUser ? String(qllUser.id) : "",
    qll_name: qllUser ? displayName(qllUser) : "",
    request_content: replyTo?.text ?? "",
    ctv_name: ctvUser ? displayName(ctvUser) : "",
    response_content: message.text ?? "",
    status,
  };
}

function stripDiacritics(str: string): string {
  return str
    .normalize("NFD")
    .replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g, "")
    .replace(/[Ä‘Ä]/g, "d")
    .toLowerCase();
}

const URGENT_PHRASES_NO_ACCENT = [
  "ho tro ngay",
  "gay gat",
  "buc xuc",
  "khan cap",
  "goi gap",
  "can gap",
  "ho tro gap",
  "xu ly gap",
  "check gap",
  "kiem tra gap",
  "khieu nai",
  "phan nan",
  "can ngay",
  "duyet",
];

export function isUrgentQllMessage(text: string): boolean {
  const trimmed = text.trim();
  if (trimmed === "") return false;
  const lower = trimmed.toLowerCase();
  if (/(?:^|[\s,.!?:;("'])gáº¥p(?:$|[\s,.!?:;)"'])/.test(lower)) {
    if (!lower.includes("gáº¥p Ä‘Ă´i") && !lower.includes("gáº¥p sĂ¡ch")) {
      return true;
    }
  }
  const noAccent = stripDiacritics(trimmed);
  return URGENT_PHRASES_NO_ACCENT.some((phrase) => noAccent.includes(phrase));
}

// --- HĂ€M KIá»‚M TRA ÄIá»€U KIá»†N KEY NHáº¬N DIá»†N CASE Má»I ---
export function isValidQllCaseMessage(text: string): boolean {
  const trimmed = text.trim();
  if (trimmed === "") return false;

  // 1. Kiá»ƒm tra tá»« khĂ³a kháº©n cáº¥p
  if (isUrgentQllMessage(trimmed)) {
    return true;
  }

  // 2. Äiá»u kiá»‡n HOáº¶C: Chá»©a tá»« 3 chá»¯ sá»‘ trá»Ÿ lĂªn HOáº¶C chá»©a tiá»n tá»‘ mĂ£ lá»›p
  const hasMin3Digits = /\d{3,}/.test(trimmed);
  
  const classPrefixes = ["toan", "moet", "khtn", "tclc", "ta", "tvtth"];
  const lowerText = stripDiacritics(trimmed);
  const hasClassPrefix = classPrefixes.some((prefix) => lowerText.includes(prefix));

  return hasMin3Digits || hasClassPrefix;
}


// Quy Ä‘á»‹nh khung giá» ca lĂ m viá»‡c chuáº©n:
// SĂ¡ng: 8g - 12g (gĂ¡nh Ä‘áº¿n trÆ°á»›c 13h30)
// Chiá»u: 13h30 - 17g (gĂ¡nh tá»« 13h30 Ä‘áº¿n trÆ°á»›c 17h30)
// Tá»‘i: 17h30 - 21h30 (gĂ¡nh tá»« 17h30 trá»Ÿ Ä‘i)
export function getCurrentShiftVn(now: Date = new Date()): {
  key: "sang" | "chieu" | "toi";
  label: string;
} {
  const vnTime = new Date(now.getTime() + VN_OFFSET_MS);
  const hour = vnTime.getUTCHours();
  const minute = vnTime.getUTCMinutes();
  const timeVal = hour + minute / 60;

  if (timeVal < 13.5) return { key: "sang", label: "SĂ¡ng" };
  if (timeVal >= 13.5 && timeVal < 17.5) return { key: "chieu", label: "Chiá»u" };
  return { key: "toi", label: "Tá»‘i" };
}

export function getActiveCoordinator(
  config: ShiftCoordinatorConfig,
  now: Date = new Date()
): { username: string; shiftLabel: string } {
  const shift = getCurrentShiftVn(now);
  const raw = config[shift.key] || config.defaultDp || "HuyNQ5";
  return {
    username: raw.replace(/^@/, "").trim(),
    shiftLabel: shift.label,
  };
}

export async function loadMonitorConfig(
  client: SupabaseClient
): Promise<ShiftCoordinatorConfig> {
  if (!client || typeof client.from !== "function") return DEFAULT_CONFIG;
  try {
    const { data, error } = await client
      .from("pending_batches")
      .select("items")
      .eq("admin_id", CONFIG_ROW_ID)
      .maybeSingle();
    if (error || !data?.items) return DEFAULT_CONFIG;
    const raw = data.items as Partial<ShiftCoordinatorConfig>;
    return {
      sang: raw.sang || DEFAULT_CONFIG.sang,
      chieu: raw.chieu || DEFAULT_CONFIG.chieu,
      toi: raw.toi || DEFAULT_CONFIG.toi,
      defaultDp: raw.defaultDp || DEFAULT_CONFIG.defaultDp,
      ctvUsernames: Array.isArray(raw.ctvUsernames)
        ? raw.ctvUsernames
        : DEFAULT_CONFIG.ctvUsernames,
      ctvSang: Array.isArray(raw.ctvSang) ? raw.ctvSang : [],
      ctvChieu: Array.isArray(raw.ctvChieu) ? raw.ctvChieu : [],
      ctvToi: Array.isArray(raw.ctvToi) ? raw.ctvToi : [],
      userTitles: raw.userTitles && typeof raw.userTitles === "object" ? raw.userTitles : {},
    };
  } catch {
    return DEFAULT_CONFIG;
  }
}

export async function saveMonitorConfig(
  client: SupabaseClient,
  config: ShiftCoordinatorConfig
): Promise<boolean> {
  if (!client || typeof client.from !== "function") return false;
  try {
    const { error } = await client
      .from("pending_batches")
      .upsert(
        { admin_id: CONFIG_ROW_ID, items: config as unknown },
        { onConflict: "admin_id" }
      );
    return !error;
  } catch {
    return false;
  }
}

export async function loadWatchedMessages(
  client: SupabaseClient
): Promise<WatchedGroupMessage[]> {
  if (!client || typeof client.from !== "function") return [];
  try {
    const { data, error } = await client
      .from("pending_batches")
      .select("items")
      .eq("admin_id", WATCH_ROW_ID)
      .maybeSingle();
    if (error || !Array.isArray(data?.items)) return [];
    return data.items as WatchedGroupMessage[];
  } catch {
    return [];
  }
}

export async function saveWatchedMessages(
  client: SupabaseClient,
  list: WatchedGroupMessage[]
): Promise<void> {
  if (!client || typeof client.from !== "function") return;
  try {
    await client
      .from("pending_batches")
      .upsert(
        { admin_id: WATCH_ROW_ID, items: list as unknown },
        { onConflict: "admin_id" }
      );
  } catch {
    // ignore
  }
}

// Xá»­ lĂ½ cĂ¡c lá»‡nh quáº£n lĂ½ /dp, /Ä‘p, /addctv, /addctvca, /settitle, /delctv
export async function maybeHandleCoordinatorCommands(
  message: TelegramMessage,
  telegram: TelegramClient,
  supabase: SupabaseClient,
  text: string
): Promise<boolean> {
  const trimmed = text.trim();
  const lower = trimmed.toLowerCase();

  if (
    lower === "/dp" ||
    lower === "/Ä‘p" ||
    lower.startsWith("/dp ") ||
    lower.startsWith("/Ä‘p ")
  ) {
    const config = await loadMonitorConfig(supabase);
    const argStr = trimmed.replace(/^\/(dp|Ä‘p)\b/i, "").trim();

    if (argStr === "") {
      const active = getActiveCoordinator(config);

      await telegram.sendMessage(

        ].join("\n")

      return true;
    }

    const parts = argStr.split(/\s+/);
    if (parts.length === 1) {
      const uname = parts[0].replace(/^@/, "").trim();
      config.sang = uname;
      config.chieu = uname;
      config.toi = uname;
      config.defaultDp = uname;
      await saveMonitorConfig(supabase, config);
      await telegram.sendMessage(
        message.chat.id,
        `âœ… ÄĂ£ gĂ¡n Ä‘iá»u phá»‘i viĂªn cho táº¥t cáº£ cĂ¡c ca: @${uname}`
      );
      return true;
    }

    const shiftRaw = stripDiacritics(parts[0]);
    const uname = parts[1].replace(/^@/, "").trim();
    if (!uname) {
      await telegram.sendMessage(
        message.chat.id,
        "CĂº phĂ¡p: /Ä‘p <sĂ¡ng|chiá»u|tá»‘i> <username> (VD: /Ä‘p tá»‘i HuyNQ5)"
      );
      return true;
    }

    if (shiftRaw === "sang") {
      config.sang = uname;
      await saveMonitorConfig(supabase, config);
      await telegram.sendMessage(
        message.chat.id,
        `âœ… ÄĂ£ gĂ¡n Ä‘iá»u phá»‘i Ca SĂ¡ng: @${uname}`
      );
      return true;
    }
    if (shiftRaw === "chieu") {
      config.chieu = uname;
      await saveMonitorConfig(supabase, config);
      await telegram.sendMessage(
        message.chat.id,
        `âœ… ÄĂ£ gĂ¡n Ä‘iá»u phá»‘i Ca Chiá»u: @${uname}`
      );
      return true;
    }
    if (shiftRaw === "toi") {
      config.toi = uname;
      await saveMonitorConfig(supabase, config);
      await telegram.sendMessage(
        message.chat.id,
        `âœ… ÄĂ£ gĂ¡n Ä‘iá»u phá»‘i Ca Tá»‘i: @${uname}`
      );
      return true;

      message.chat.id,
      "Ca khĂ´ng há»£p lá»‡. DĂ¹ng: /Ä‘p sĂ¡ng <user>, /Ä‘p chiá»u <user>, hoáº·c /Ä‘p tá»‘i <user>"

    return true;
  }

  if (lower.startsWith("/settitle")) {
    const rest = trimmed.slice("/settitle".length).trim();
    const parts = rest.split(/\s+/);
    const uname = parts[0]?.replace(/^@/, "").trim().toLowerCase();
    const titleArg = stripDiacritics(parts[1] || "").toLowerCase();

    if (uname && (titleArg === "anh" || titleArg === "chi" || titleArg === "chá»‹")) {
      const config = await loadMonitorConfig(supabase);
      if (!config.userTitles) config.userTitles = {};
      const resolvedTitle = titleArg.startsWith("chi") ? "chá»‹" : "anh";
      config.userTitles[uname] = resolvedTitle;

        message.chat.id,
        `âœ… ÄĂ£ lÆ°u danh xÆ°ng cho @${uname}: **${resolvedTitle}**`

        message.chat.id,
        "â ï¸ Sai cĂº phĂ¡p! DĂ¹ng: /settitle @username <anh|chá»‹>"
      );
    }
    return true;
  }

  if (lower.startsWith("/addctvca")) {
    const rest = trimmed.slice("/addctvca".length).trim();
    if (!rest) {
      await telegram.sendMessage(
        message.chat.id,
        "CĂº phĂ¡p: /addctvca <sang|chieu|toi> @username1 @username2"
      );
      return true;
    }

    const shiftType = stripDiacritics(parts[0] || "");
    const usernames = parts
      .slice(1)
      .map((u) => u.replace(/^@/, "").trim().toLowerCase())
      .filter(Boolean);

    if (["sang", "chieu", "toi"].includes(shiftType) && usernames.length > 0) {
      const config = await loadMonitorConfig(supabase);

      if (shiftType === "sang") config.ctvSang = usernames;
      if (shiftType === "chieu") config.ctvChieu = usernames;
      if (shiftType === "toi") config.ctvToi = usernames;

      await saveMonitorConfig(supabase, config);
      await telegram.sendMessage(
        message.chat.id,
        `âœ… ÄĂ£ lÆ°u thĂ nh cĂ´ng ${usernames.length} CTV cho ca ${shiftType.toUpperCase()}: ${usernames
          .map((u) => `@${u}`)
          .join(", ")}`
      );
    } else {
      await telegram.sendMessage(
        message.chat.id,
        "â ï¸ Sai cĂº phĂ¡p! DĂ¹ng: /addctvca <sang|chieu|toi> @user1 @user2"
      );
    }
    return true;
  }

  // --- [THĂM Má»I] Lá»†NH /delctvca (XĂ³a CTV theo ca) ---
  if (lower.startsWith("/delctvca")) {
    const rest = trimmed.slice("/delctvca".length).trim();
    const parts = rest.split(/\s+/);
    if (parts.length < 2) {
      await telegram.sendMessage(
        message.chat.id,
        "CĂº phĂ¡p: /delctvca <sang|chieu|toi> @username"
      );
      return true;
    }

    const shiftType = stripDiacritics(parts[0] || "");
    const targetUname = parts[1].replace(/^@/, "").trim().toLowerCase();

    if (!["sang", "chieu", "toi"].includes(shiftType) || !targetUname) {
      await telegram.sendMessage(
        message.chat.id,
        "â ï¸ Sai cĂº phĂ¡p! DĂ¹ng: /delctvca <sang|chieu|toi> @username"
      );
      return true;
    }

    const config = await loadMonitorConfig(supabase);
    let targetKey: "ctvSang" | "ctvChieu" | "ctvToi" = "ctvSang";
    if (shiftType === "chieu") targetKey = "ctvChieu";
    if (shiftType === "toi") targetKey = "ctvToi";

    const currentList = config[targetKey] || [];
    const updatedList = currentList.filter((u) => u.toLowerCase() !== targetUname);
    config[targetKey] = updatedList;

    await saveMonitorConfig(supabase, config);
    await telegram.sendMessage(
      message.chat.id,
      `â™»ï¸ ÄĂ£ xĂ³a @${targetUname} khá»i ca **${shiftType.toUpperCase()}**. CĂ²n láº¡i (${updatedList.length}): ${
        updatedList.length > 0 ? updatedList.map((u) => `@${u}`).join(", ") : "(trá»‘ng)"
      }`
    );
    return true;
  }

  // --- Lá»†NH ADDCTV CÅ¨ ---
  if (lower.startsWith("/addctv")) {
    const rest = trimmed.slice("/addctv".length).trim();
    if (!rest) {
      await telegram.sendMessage(
        message.chat.id,
        "CĂº phĂ¡p: /addctv @username1 @username2"
      );
      return true;
    }
    const config = await loadMonitorConfig(supabase);
    const tokens = rest
      .split(/[\s,]+/)
      .map((t) => t.replace(/^@/, "").trim().toLowerCase())
      .filter(Boolean);
    const set = new Set(config.ctvUsernames.map((u) => u.toLowerCase()));
    for (const t of tokens) set.add(t);
    config.ctvUsernames = Array.from(set);
    await saveMonitorConfig(supabase, config);
    await telegram.sendMessage(
      message.chat.id,
      `âœ… ÄĂ£ cáº­p nháº­t danh sĂ¡ch CTV Váº­n hĂ nh (${config.ctvUsernames.length}): ${config.ctvUsernames
        .map((u) => `@${u}`)
        .join(", ")}`
    );
    return true;
  }

  // --- Lá»†NH DELCTV CÅ¨ ---
  if (lower.startsWith("/delctv")) {
    const rest = trimmed.slice("/delctv".length).trim();
    if (!rest) {
      await telegram.sendMessage(message.chat.id, "CĂº phĂ¡p: /delctv @username");
      return true;
    }
    const config = await loadMonitorConfig(supabase);
    const toRemove = new Set(
      rest
        .split(/[\s,]+/)
        .map((t) => t.replace(/^@/, "").trim().toLowerCase())
        .filter(Boolean)
    );
    config.ctvUsernames = config.ctvUsernames.filter(
      (u) => !toRemove.has(u.toLowerCase())
    );
    await saveMonitorConfig(supabase, config);
    await telegram.sendMessage(
      message.chat.id,
      `â™»ï¸ ÄĂ£ xĂ³a khá»i danh sĂ¡ch CTV. CĂ²n láº¡i (${config.ctvUsernames.length}): ${config.ctvUsernames
        .map((u) => `@${u}`)
        .join(", ")}`
    );
    return true;
  }

  return false;
}

// Báº¯t sá»± kiá»‡n tháº£ Icon (Reaction) trong nhĂ³m Ä‘á»ƒ giáº£i phĂ³ng SLA
export async function handleGroupReaction(
  reaction: any, 
  supabase: SupabaseClient,
  targetChatId: number
): Promise<void> {
  // Láº¥y chat_id linh hoáº¡t tá»« payload reaction Ä‘á»ƒ trĂ¡nh trÆ°á»ng há»£p Telegram tráº£ vá» thiáº¿u cáº¥u trĂºc chat
  const chatId = reaction.chat?.id || reaction.message_chat_id || targetChatId;
  if (targetChatId && chatId !== targetChatId) return;

  // Chá»‰ gá»¡ SLA khi cĂ³ thao tĂ¡c THĂM icon má»›i
  if (!Array.isArray(reaction.new_reaction) || reaction.new_reaction.length === 0) {
    return;
  }
  
  const watched = await loadWatchedMessages(supabase);
  
  // So khá»›p chĂ­nh xĂ¡c message_id Ä‘á»ƒ xĂ³a khá»i hĂ ng Ä‘á»£i SLA
  const filtered = watched.filter((w) => w.messageId !== reaction.message_id);
  
  if (filtered.length !== watched.length) {
    await saveWatchedMessages(supabase, filtered);
  }
}

// --- CĂC HĂ€M PHá»¤ TRá»¢ Xá»¬ LĂ DATABASE & REACTION ---

export async function insertQllCase(
  client: SupabaseClient,
  record: { message_id: number; chat_id: number; sender_id: number; sender_name: string; content: string }
) {
  if (!client || typeof client.from !== "function") return;
  try {
    await client.from("qll_tracking").upsert(
      { ...record, handled: false, reported: false },
      { onConflict: "message_id" }
    );
  } catch (e) {
    console.error("Lá»—i insertQllCase:", e);
  }
}

export async function markCaseHandled(client: SupabaseClient, messageId: number) {
  if (!client || typeof client.from !== "function") return;
  try {
    await client.from("qll_tracking").update({ handled: true }).eq("message_id", messageId);
  } catch (e) {
    console.error("Lá»—i markCaseHandled:", e);
  }
}

export async function handleGroupQllMessage(
  message: TelegramMessage,
  telegram: TelegramClient,
  supabase: SupabaseClient,
  targetChatId: number,
  adminIds: number[]
): Promise<void> {
  if (message.chat.id !== targetChatId) return;
  if (!message.from || message.from.is_bot) return;
  if (message.new_chat_members && message.new_chat_members.length > 0) return;

  const watched = await loadWatchedMessages(supabase);
  let watchedChanged = false;

  const replyToId = message.reply_to_message?.message_id;
  if (replyToId !== undefined) {
    const afterReply = watched.filter((w) => w.messageId !== replyToId);
    if (afterReply.length !== watched.length) {
      watched.length = 0;
      watched.push(...afterReply);
      watchedChanged = true;
    }
  }

  // --- Táº¢I CONFIG TRÆ¯á»C KHI Sá»¬ Dá»¤NG ---
  const config = await loadMonitorConfig(supabase);

  const senderUname = (message.from.username ?? "").trim().toLowerCase();
  const text = (message.text ?? message.caption ?? "").trim();
  const lowerText = text.toLowerCase();

  const isCredentialReply = 
    lowerText.includes("acc:") || 
    lowerText.includes("pass:") || 
    lowerText.includes("mk:") || 
    lowerText.includes("tk:") || 
    lowerText.includes("tk gia sÆ°") ||
    lowerText.includes("e gá»­i") || 
    lowerText.includes("gá»­i láº¡i tk");

  // CHá»T CHáº¶N 1: Cháº·n tuyá»‡t Ä‘á»‘i tin nháº¯n TĂ i khoáº£n / Máº­t kháº©u
  if (isCredentialReply) {
    if (watchedChanged) await saveWatchedMessages(supabase, watched);
    return; 
  }
  
// Chuáº©n hĂ³a: Gá»t sáº¡ch dáº¥u "@" vĂ  Ä‘Æ°a vá» chá»¯ thÆ°á»ng cho toĂ n bá»™ danh sĂ¡ch CTV láº¥y tá»« DB
const listCtv = (config.ctvUsernames || []).map((u: string) => u.replace(/^@/, "").toLowerCase());
const listSang = (config?.ctvSang || []).map((u: string) => u.replace(/^@/, "").toLowerCase());
const listChieu = (config?.ctvChieu || []).map((u: string) => u.replace(/^@/, "").toLowerCase());
const listToi = (config?.ctvToi || []).map((u: string) => u.replace(/^@/, "").toLowerCase());

const isAllCtvShift =
  listSang.includes(senderUname) ||
  listChieu.includes(senderUname) ||
  listToi.includes(senderUname);

const isCtvOrAdmin =
  adminIds.includes(message.from.id) ||
  (senderUname !== "" && (listCtv.includes(senderUname) || isAllCtvShift));

  // CHá»T CHáº¶N 2: Tin nháº¯n cá»§a Admin/CTV ca trá»±c cÅ©ng bá» qua
  if (isCtvOrAdmin) {
    if (watchedChanged) await saveWatchedMessages(supabase, watched);
    return; 
  }

  if (text === "") {
    if (watchedChanged) await saveWatchedMessages(supabase, watched);
    return;
  }

  // --- Lá»P 2: Lá»ŒC RULE QLL (YĂªu cáº§u chá»©a >=3 sá»‘ hoáº·c mĂ£ lá»›p) ---
  if (!isValidQllCaseMessage(text)) {
    if (watchedChanged) await saveWatchedMessages(supabase, watched);
    return; // Sai format QLL -> ThoĂ¡t ngay láº­p tá»©c
  }

  // --- Lá»P 3: CHá»ˆ CĂ’N Láº I TIN NHáº®N CHUáº¨N Cá»¦A QLL -> LÆ¯U DATABASE ---
  const senderName = message.from.first_name 
    ? `${message.from.first_name} ${message.from.last_name || ""}`.trim() 
    : senderUname || "QLL";
    
  await insertQllCase(supabase, {
    message_id: message.message_id,
    chat_id: message.chat.id,
    sender_id: message.from.id,
    sender_name: senderName,
    content: text,
  });


  // 2. PUSH VĂ€O Máº¢NG Äá»‚ TĂNH SLA 5 PHĂT
  watched.push({
    messageId: message.message_id,
    chatId: message.chat.id,
    senderId: message.from.id,
    createdAtMs: Date.now(),
  });
  watchedChanged = true;

  if (isUrgentQllMessage(text)) {
    const { username } = getActiveCoordinator(config);
    const titles = config.userTitles || {};
    const dpTitle = titles[username.toLowerCase()] || "anh/chá»‹";
    await telegram.sendMessage(
      message.chat.id,
      `Dáº¡ ${dpTitle} @${username} Æ¡i case nĂ y cáº§n há»— trá»£ áº¡ !`,
      message.message_id
    );
  }

  if (watchedChanged) {
    await saveWatchedMessages(supabase, watched);
  }
}

// HĂ m kiá»ƒm tra SLA 5 phĂºt (Cháº¡y trong Cron) - QuĂ¡ 5 phĂºt khĂ´ng ai tháº£ tim/reply sáº½ tag random CTV trong ca
export async function checkUnansweredMessages(
  telegram: TelegramClient,
  supabase: SupabaseClient,
  nowMs: number = Date.now()
): Promise<void> {
  if (!supabase || typeof supabase.from !== "function") return;

  const watched = await loadWatchedMessages(supabase);
  if (watched.length === 0) return;

  const config = await loadMonitorConfig(supabase);
  const { username } = getActiveCoordinator(config, new Date(nowMs));
  const currentShift = getCurrentShiftVn(new Date(nowMs));
  const titles = config.userTitles || {};

  let currentShiftCtv: string[] = [];
  if (currentShift.key === "sang") currentShiftCtv = config.ctvSang || [];
  else if (currentShift.key === "chieu") currentShiftCtv = config.ctvChieu || [];
  else currentShiftCtv = config.ctvToi || [];

  const remaining: WatchedGroupMessage[] = [];
  let changed = false;

  for (const item of watched) {
    const ageMs = nowMs - item.createdAtMs;
    if (ageMs > 12 * 60 * 60 * 1000) {
      changed = true;
      continue;
    }

    if (ageMs >= SLA_TIMEOUT_MS) {
      // QuĂ¡ 5 phĂºt khĂ´ng ai tháº£ tim/nháº­n -> Tag Ä‘Ăºng anh/chá»‹ CTV ca Ä‘Ă³ hoáº·c Ä‘iá»u phá»‘i
      if (currentShiftCtv.length > 0) {
        const randomCtv = currentShiftCtv[Math.floor(Math.random() * currentShiftCtv.length)];
        const title = titles[randomCtv.toLowerCase()] || "anh/chá»‹";
        await telegram.sendMessage(
          item.chatId,
          `Dáº¡ ${title} @${randomCtv} Æ¡i case nĂ y cáº§n há»— trá»£ áº¡ !`,
          item.messageId
        );
      } else {
        const dpTitle = titles[username.toLowerCase()] || "anh/chá»‹";
        await telegram.sendMessage(
          item.chatId,
          `Dáº¡ ${dpTitle} @${username} Æ¡i case nĂ y cáº§n há»— trá»£ áº¡ !`,
          item.messageId
        );
      }
      changed = true;
    } else {
      remaining.push(item);
    }
  }

  if (changed) {
    await saveWatchedMessages(supabase, remaining);
  }
}

export async function updateConfig(
  supabase: SupabaseClient,
  newConfig: Record<string, any>
): Promise<void> {
  const CONFIG_ROW_ID = -9001;

  const { data } = await supabase
    .from("pending_batches")
    .select("items")
    .eq("admin_id", CONFIG_ROW_ID)
    .single();

  let existingItems = data?.items || {};
  if (typeof existingItems !== "object") {
    existingItems = {};
  }

  const updatedItems = { ...existingItems, ...newConfig };

  await supabase
    .from("pending_batches")
    .upsert(
      {
        admin_id: CONFIG_ROW_ID,
        items: updatedItems,
        created_at: new Date().toISOString(),
      },
      { onConflict: "admin_id" }
    );
}
 
export async function sendReaction(
  chatId: number,
  messageId: number,
  emoji: string = "đŸ‘"
): Promise<boolean> {
  try {
    const token = process.env.BOT_TOKEN || process.env.TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN;
    if (!token) {
      console.log("âŒ Thiáº¿u BOT_TOKEN");
      return false;
    }

    const url = `https://api.telegram.org/bot${token}/setMessageReaction`;
    const response = await fetch(url, {
      method: "POST",
      headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
      body: JSON.stringify({
        chat_id: chatId,
        message_id: messageId,
        reaction: [{ type: "emoji", emoji: emoji }],
      }),
    });

    const data = (await response.json()) as {
      ok: boolean;
      description?: string;
    };

    if (!data.ok) {
      console.error("âŒ Telegram tá»« chá»‘i tháº£ icon:", data.description);
    }

    return data.ok;
  } catch (error) {
    console.error("âŒ Lá»—i máº¡ng khi gá»i sendReaction:", error);
    return false;
  }
}

// Pure QLL-name -> Telegram-username mapping. No I/O: the known-username list
// is injected so the hard-to-get-right normalization rule can be unit-tested
// without a database. See .agents/tasks/batch-plan.md for the full rule.

// normalize(s): NFD, strip combining diacritics, map Ä‘/Ä -> d, lowercase, and
// remove every character outside [a-z0-9].
export function normalize(s: string): string {
  return s
    .normalize("NFD")
    .replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g, "") // strip combining marks
    .replace(/[Ä‘Ä]/g, "d") // Vietnamese stroked-d is NOT a combining mark
    .toLowerCase()
    .replace(/[^a-z0-9]/g, "");
}

// nameToCore(fullName): a Vietnamese name is "<Há»> <Äá»‡m...> <TĂªn> [<Sá»‘>]".
// The LAST token is a trailing number when it is all digits (may be absent);
// the token before it is the given name (TĂªn); every leading token is a
// family/middle word. core = normalize(TĂªn) + normalize(initials of each
// family/middle word) + number.
// Example: "Nguyá»…n Háº£i HĂ  3" -> "ha" + "nh" + "3" = "hanh3".
export function nameToCore(fullName: string): string {
  const tokens = fullName.split(/\s+/).filter((t) => t.length > 0);
  if (tokens.length === 0) {
    return "";
  }

  let number = "";
  if (/^\d+$/.test(tokens[tokens.length - 1])) {
    number = tokens.pop() as string;
  }
  if (tokens.length === 0) {
    return number;
  }

  const given = tokens.pop() as string; // TĂªn
  const familyMiddle = tokens; // leading words (may be empty)
  const initials = familyMiddle.map((w) => w.charAt(0)).join("");

  return normalize(given) + normalize(initials) + number;
}

// usernameToCore(username): strip a leading role prefix (SA/OP/VH) and an
// optional following underscore, then normalize the remainder.
// Example: "SA_HaNH3" -> "hanh3", "SAAnhPTH5" -> "anhpth5".
export function usernameToCore(username: string): string {
  const stripped = username.replace(/^(sa|op|vh)_?/i, "");
  return normalize(stripped);
}

export type QllMatch =
  | { kind: "found"; username: string }
  | { kind: "ambiguous"; candidates: string[] }
  | { kind: "notFound" };

// A known QLL as stored: its Telegram username plus the full name on record
// (from auto-collection or a manual /adduser).
export interface KnownUser {
  username: string;
  full_name: string;
}

// mapQllByUser(name, users): the preferred mapper when full names are known.
// It FIRST tries an exact normalized full-name match (so a manually-added QLL
// like "Nguyá»…n KhĂ¡nh UyĂªn" -> @SA_Uyennk86 resolves even though the username
// carries a trailing number the name does not). Only if no full-name matches
// does it fall back to the derived-core rule (mapQll). This makes /adduser
// authoritative: whatever name you registered maps to its username verbatim.
export function mapQllByUser(name: string, users: KnownUser[]): QllMatch {
  const wanted = normalize(name);
  if (wanted !== "") {
    const byName = users.filter((u) => normalize(u.full_name) === wanted);
    if (byName.length === 1) {
      return { kind: "found", username: byName[0].username };
    }
    if (byName.length >= 2) {
      // Same registered name on multiple usernames: let the caller disambiguate
      // rather than guess.
      return { kind: "ambiguous", candidates: byName.map((u) => u.username) };
    }
  }
  // No exact full-name hit -> fall back to the derived-core rule.
  return mapQll(name, users.map((u) => u.username));
}

// mapQll(name, knownUsernames): compute the name's core and collect every known
// username whose core matches exactly. 0 -> notFound, 1 -> found, >=2 ->
// ambiguous. Exact-core equality only (no fuzzy matching, per spec).
export function mapQll(name: string, knownUsernames: string[]): QllMatch {
  const target = nameToCore(name);
  if (target === "") {
    return { kind: "notFound" };
  }

  const candidates = knownUsernames.filter(
    (u) => usernameToCore(u) === target
  );

  if (candidates.length === 0) {
    return { kind: "notFound" };
  }
  if (candidates.length === 1) {
    return { kind: "found", username: candidates[0] };
  }
  return { kind: "ambiguous", candidates };
}



=== FILE: lib\schedule.ts ===
// Pure parser for the admin's /ok command, with optional "háº¹n giá»" scheduling.
//
// The admin may schedule WHEN a confirmed batch starts sending, expressed in
// Vietnam wall-clock time (fixed UTC+7, no DST):
//   /ok            -> send now (unchanged)
//   /ok 21:00      -> start at 21:00 TODAY VN; if already past, roll to tomorrow
//   /ok 16/10 21:00-> 21:00 on 16 Oct (dd/mm) of the current VN year; if past,
//                     roll to next year
//
// No timezone library is used: VNâ†’UTC is a fixed âˆ’7h shift computed with
// Date.UTC + millisecond arithmetic, which handles date/month/year rollover
// automatically. `now` is injectable so tests are fully deterministic.

// Vietnam is a fixed UTC+7 offset (no daylight saving).
const VN_OFFSET_MS = 7 * 60 * 60 * 1000;

export type ParseResult =
  | { kind: "now" }
  | { kind: "at"; sendAfterIso: string }
  | { kind: "invalid"; reason: string };

// Friendly Vietnamese reason shown to the admin when the time/date is invalid.
const INVALID_REASON =
  "Giá» háº¹n khĂ´ng há»£p lá»‡. DĂ¹ng: /ok, hoáº·c /ok 21:00, hoáº·c /ok 16/10 21:00.";

// Converts a VN wall-clock (year, month 1-12, day, hour, minute) to the UTC
// instant it refers to, returned as an ISO string. VN is UTC+7, so the UTC
// instant is 7 hours BEFORE the same wall-clock read as UTC. Date.UTC plus the
// millisecond subtraction normalizes any date/month/year rollover.
function vnWallClockToUtcIso(
  year: number,
  month1to12: number,
  day: number,
  hour: number,
  minute: number
): string {
  const utcMs = Date.UTC(year, month1to12 - 1, day, hour, minute) - VN_OFFSET_MS;
  return new Date(utcMs).toISOString();
}

// Reads `now` as VN wall-clock parts. Shifting the instant forward by the VN
// offset and then reading the UTC getters yields VN local Y/M/D/h/m.
function vnPartsOf(now: Date): {
  year: number;
  month1to12: number;
  day: number;
} {
  const shifted = new Date(now.getTime() + VN_OFFSET_MS);
  return {
    year: shifted.getUTCFullYear(),
    month1to12: shifted.getUTCMonth() + 1,
    day: shifted.getUTCDate(),
  };
}

// Formats a UTC ISO instant as "HH:MM dd/mm" in VN time, for confirmations.
export function formatVnDateTime(iso: string): string {
  const shifted = new Date(new Date(iso).getTime() + VN_OFFSET_MS);
  const hh = String(shifted.getUTCHours()).padStart(2, "0");
  const mm = String(shifted.getUTCMinutes()).padStart(2, "0");
  const dd = String(shifted.getUTCDate()).padStart(2, "0");
  const mo = String(shifted.getUTCMonth() + 1).padStart(2, "0");
  return `${hh}:${mm} ${dd}/${mo}`;
}

function isValidHourMinute(hour: number, minute: number): boolean {
  return hour >= 0 && hour <= 23 && minute >= 0 && minute <= 59;
}

// Builds the next occurrence of HH:MM VN relative to `now`: today's VN date if
// that instant is still in the future, otherwise tomorrow VN.
function nextDailyOccurrenceIso(now: Date, hour: number, minute: number): string {
  const { year, month1to12, day } = vnPartsOf(now);
  let iso = vnWallClockToUtcIso(year, month1to12, day, hour, minute);
  if (new Date(iso).getTime() <= now.getTime()) {
    // Already passed today VN â†’ same time tomorrow VN (Date.UTC rolls over).
    iso = vnWallClockToUtcIso(year, month1to12, day + 1, hour, minute);
  }
  return iso;
}

// Builds dd/mm HH:MM for the current VN year; if that instant already passed,
// uses next year.
function nextDatedOccurrenceIso(
  now: Date,
  day: number,
  month1to12: number,
  hour: number,
  minute: number
): string {
  const { year } = vnPartsOf(now);
  let iso = vnWallClockToUtcIso(year, month1to12, day, hour, minute);
  if (new Date(iso).getTime() <= now.getTime()) {
    iso = vnWallClockToUtcIso(year + 1, month1to12, day, hour, minute);
  }
  return iso;
}

// Parses the admin's /ok command. `now` is injectable for deterministic tests.
export function parseOkCommand(
  text: string,
  now: Date = new Date()
): ParseResult {
  const trimmed = text.trim();
  const lower = trimmed.toLowerCase();

  // Must start with the /ok command token.
  if (lower !== "/ok" && !lower.startsWith("/ok ")) {
    // Caller only routes here on a /ok prefix, but stay defensive: a bare
    // "/oksomething" (no space) is not a valid /ok command.
    if (!lower.startsWith("/ok")) {
      return { kind: "invalid", reason: INVALID_REASON };
    }
  }

  // The argument is everything after the leading "/ok", whitespace-collapsed.
  const arg = trimmed.slice(3).replace(/\s+/g, " ").trim();
  if (arg === "") {
    return { kind: "now" };
  }

  // HH:MM form.
  const timeMatch = /^(\d{1,2}):(\d{2})$/.exec(arg);
  if (timeMatch) {
    const hour = Number(timeMatch[1]);
    const minute = Number(timeMatch[2]);
    if (!isValidHourMinute(hour, minute)) {
      return { kind: "invalid", reason: INVALID_REASON };
    }
    return { kind: "at", sendAfterIso: nextDailyOccurrenceIso(now, hour, minute) };
  }

  // dd/mm HH:MM form.
  const dateMatch = /^(\d{1,2})\/(\d{1,2})\s+(\d{1,2}):(\d{2})$/.exec(arg);
  if (dateMatch) {
    const day = Number(dateMatch[1]);
    const month = Number(dateMatch[2]);
    const hour = Number(dateMatch[3]);
    const minute = Number(dateMatch[4]);
    if (
      day < 1 ||
      day > 31 ||
      month < 1 ||
      month > 12 ||
      !isValidHourMinute(hour, minute)
    ) {
      return { kind: "invalid", reason: INVALID_REASON };
    }
    return {
      kind: "at",
      sendAfterIso: nextDatedOccurrenceIso(now, day, month, hour, minute),
    };
  }

  return { kind: "invalid", reason: INVALID_REASON };
}
