import { afterEach, beforeEach, describe, expect, it, vi } from "vitest";
import type { SupabaseClient } from "@supabase/supabase-js";
import { handleUpdate, type Deps } from "../lib/handler.js";
import * as XLSX from "xlsx";
import type {
  SendResult,
  DeleteResult,
  DownloadResult,
  TelegramClient,
} from "../lib/telegram.js";
import type { MappedItem, TelegramUpdate } from "../lib/types.js";
import { buildGroupedAnnouncement } from "../lib/batch.js";

const WARNING =
  "â ï¸ ÄĂ£ áº©n thĂ´ng tin! QLL cáº§n báº¥m /start á»Ÿ khung chat riĂªng vá»›i Bot Ä‘á»ƒ nháº­n Inbox.";

// Records an ordered trace of every mock interaction so we can assert ordering.
function makeDeps(options: {
  sendResults?: SendResult[];
  sendThrows?: Error[]; // index-aligned; if set, that send call throws
  // index-aligned; if true, that send returns a promise that never settles
  // (used with fake timers to drive the real 10s withTimeout boundary)
  sendPending?: boolean[];
  deleteResults?: DeleteResult[];
  relayEnabled?: boolean;
  // Batch feature: control downloadFile and the pending_batches / username
  // queries used by maybeHandleBatch.
  downloadResult?: DownloadResult;
  pendingItems?: MappedItem[] | null;
  knownUsernames?: string[];
  // Rows that deleteUnsent (/cancel) should report as removed.
  unsentRows?: { id: string }[];
  // When set, a username lookup (findUserByUsername / dedup) returns this as an
  // already-existing QLL row, so /adduser reports "Ä‘Ă£ cĂ³".
  existingUser?: { username: string; fullName: string };
}): {
  deps: Deps;
  trace: string[];
  sendMessage: ReturnType<typeof vi.fn>;
  deleteMessage: ReturnType<typeof vi.fn>;
  downloadFile: ReturnType<typeof vi.fn>;
  insert: ReturnType<typeof vi.fn>;
  upsert: ReturnType<typeof vi.fn>;
  pendingUpsert: ReturnType<typeof vi.fn>;
  pendingDeleteEq: ReturnType<typeof vi.fn>;
  sendQueueInsert: ReturnType<typeof vi.fn>;
  sendQueueDelete: ReturnType<typeof vi.fn>;
  from: ReturnType<typeof vi.fn>;
} {
  const trace: string[] = [];
  let sendIdx = 0;
  let deleteIdx = 0;

  const sendResults = options.sendResults ?? [];
  const sendThrows = options.sendThrows ?? [];
  const sendPending = options.sendPending ?? [];
  const deleteResults = options.deleteResults ?? [];

  const sendMessage = vi.fn((chatId: number, _text: string) => {
    const i = sendIdx++;
    trace.push(`send:${chatId}`);
    if (sendPending[i]) {
      // A promise that never settles; the handler's withTimeout must fire.
      return new Promise<SendResult>(() => {});
    }
    if (sendThrows[i]) {
      return Promise.reject(sendThrows[i]);
    }
    return Promise.resolve(
      sendResults[i] ?? ({ ok: true, messageId: 1 } as SendResult)
    );
  });

  const deleteMessage = vi.fn(async (chatId: number, messageId: number) => {
    const i = deleteIdx++;
    trace.push(`delete:${chatId}:${messageId}`);
    return deleteResults[i] ?? ({ ok: true } as DeleteResult);
  });

  const downloadFile = vi.fn(async (_fileId: string) => {
    trace.push("download");
    return (
      options.downloadResult ??
      ({ ok: false, description: "no download set" } as DownloadResult)
    );
  });

  const telegram: TelegramClient = { sendMessage, deleteMessage, downloadFile };

  // Records each inserted log row in the trace.
  const insert = vi.fn(async (record: { status: string }) => {
    trace.push(`log:${record.status}`);
    return { error: null };
  });
  // User upserts (passive collection) are asserted via the `upsert` spy, not
  // via the ordered `trace`, so relay-ordering assertions stay focused.
  const upsert = vi.fn(async (_record: { telegram_id: number }) => {
    return { error: null };
  });

  // pending_batches query-builder stubs.
  const pendingUpsert = vi.fn(async () => {
    trace.push("savePending");
    return { error: null };
  });
  const pendingDeleteEq = vi.fn(async () => {
    trace.push("deletePending");
    return { error: null };
  });
  const pendingSelectMaybeSingle = vi.fn(async () => ({
    data:
      options.pendingItems === undefined || options.pendingItems === null
        ? null
        : { items: options.pendingItems },
    error: null,
  }));

  // telegram_users_qll .select(...) is used two ways:
  //  - listUsernames: `await select("username")` -> the injected known list.
  //  - findUserByUsername / upsertUser dedup: `select(...).ilike(...).limit(...)`
  //    -> rows matching an existing username (empty unless options.existingUser
  //    is set, so by default a /adduser is treated as NEW).
  const existingRows =
    options.existingUser === undefined
      ? []
      : [{ username: options.existingUser.username, full_name: options.existingUser.fullName, telegram_id: 1 }];
  const usernameSelect = vi.fn(() => {
    const listResult = {
      data: (options.knownUsernames ?? []).map((username) => ({ username })),
      error: null,
    };
    // Thenable so `await select("username")` resolves to the known list.
    const chain = {
      ilike: () => ({ limit: async () => ({ data: existingRows, error: null }) }),
      then: (resolve: (v: typeof listResult) => unknown) => resolve(listResult),
    };
    return chain;
  });
  // upsertUser's UPDATE-when-exists path: .update(...).ilike(...)
  const userUpdate = vi.fn(() => ({ ilike: async () => ({ error: null }) }));

  // send_queue: /ok uses .insert(rows); the other chainable methods are stubbed
  // so the queue helpers never throw even though /ok only exercises insert.
  const sendQueueInsert = vi.fn(async () => {
    trace.push("enqueue");
    return { error: null };
  });
  // Records a /cancel delete-unsent call.
  const sendQueueDelete = vi.fn(() => {});

  // Route .from(table) to the right query-builder stub by table name.
  const from = vi.fn((table: string) => {
    if (table === "telegram_users_qll") {
      // Passive collection + manual add use .upsert/.update; batch mapping and
      // dedup use .select (chainable with .ilike().limit()).
      return { upsert, select: usernameSelect, update: userUpdate };
    }
    if (table === "pending_batches") {
      return {
        upsert: pendingUpsert,
        select: () => ({
          eq: () => ({ maybeSingle: pendingSelectMaybeSingle }),
        }),
        delete: () => ({ eq: pendingDeleteEq }),
      };
    }
    if (table === "send_queue") {
      return {
        insert: sendQueueInsert,
        select: () => ({
          eq: () => ({
            order: () => ({ limit: async () => ({ data: [], error: null }) }),
          }),
        }),
        update: () => ({ eq: async () => ({ error: null }) }),
        // deleteUnsent: .delete().eq(admin).eq(sent=false).select("id")
        delete: () => ({
          eq: () => ({
            eq: () => ({
              select: async () => {
                sendQueueDelete();
                return {
                  data: options.unsentRows ?? [],
                  error: null,
                };
              },
            }),
          }),
        }),
      };
    }
    return { insert };
  });
  const supabase = {
    from,
  } as unknown as SupabaseClient;

  return {
    deps: {
      telegram,
      supabase,
      relayEnabled: options.relayEnabled ?? true,
    },
    trace,
    sendMessage,
    deleteMessage,
    downloadFile,
    insert,
    upsert,
    pendingUpsert,
    pendingDeleteEq,
    sendQueueInsert,
    sendQueueDelete,
    from,
  };
}

describe("handleUpdate â€” real 10s timeout behaves like 403", () => {

    vi.useRealTimers();
  });

  it("drives the actual 10,000ms timeout, then deletes -> logs -> warns in order", async () => {
    vi.useFakeTimers();
    const { deps, trace, sendMessage } = makeDeps({
      sendPending: [true], // inbox send never settles -> withTimeout fires at 10s
      deleteResults: [{ ok: true }],
    });

    const done = handleUpdate(sensitiveReply(), deps);
    // Nothing destructive should happen before the 10s boundary.
    await vi.advanceTimersByTimeAsync(9_999);
    expect(trace).toEqual([`send:${QLL_ID}`]);

    await vi.advanceTimersByTimeAsync(1);

      `delete:${GROUP_ID}:${REPLY_MSG_ID}`,
      "log:Lá»—i chÆ°a start bot",

  });

describe("handleUpdate â€” removal timing contract (send-before-delete)", () => {
  afterEach(() => {
    vi.useRealTimers();
  });

  // The Req 2.2 (delete only AFTER confirmed inbox delivery) vs. Req 10.1
  // (issue delete within 500ms of webhook receipt) conflict is resolved in the
  // AUTHORITATIVE spec: design.md "Critical action ordering" > "Timing
  // precedence" and the amended requirements.md Req 10.1 both make
  // confirmed-delivery-before-delete take precedence on the success path, so
  // credentials are never removed from the group before they reach the QLL.
  // The receipt-relative 500ms is, on the success path, a best-effort target
  // bounded by Telegram's own sendMessage latency â€” NOT a hard guarantee the
  // handler can meet when the upstream send is slow.
  //
  // This test proves the contract the resolved spec actually guarantees on the
  // success path: once delivery confirms, the delete is issued PROMPTLY (same
  // invocation, no extra wait), i.e. not blocked behind the 10s timeout budget.
  // It intentionally does NOT claim a 500ms-from-receipt SLA on the success
  // path, because that is bounded by Telegram, not by the handler.
  it("issues the group delete promptly after delivery confirms (no extra wait past the send)", async () => {
    vi.useFakeTimers();

    // The inbox send stays in flight; the delete must follow right after
    // confirmed delivery within the same invocation.
    let resolveSend: ((r: SendResult) => void) | undefined;
    const trace: string[] = [];
    const times: Record<string, number> = {};

    const sendMessage = vi.fn((chatId: number, _text: string) => {
      trace.push(`send:${chatId}`);
      if (!resolveSend) {
        return new Promise<SendResult>((resolve) => {
          resolveSend = resolve;
        });
      }
      return Promise.resolve({ ok: true, messageId: 2 } as SendResult);
    });
    const deleteMessage = vi.fn(async (chatId: number, messageId: number) => {
      trace.push(`delete:${chatId}:${messageId}`);
      times.delete = Date.now();
      return { ok: true } as DeleteResult;
    });
    const insert = vi.fn(async (record: { status: string }) => {
      trace.push(`log:${record.status}`);
      return { error: null };
    });
    const upsert = vi.fn(async () => ({ error: null }));
    const downloadFile = vi.fn();
    const deps: Deps = {
      telegram: { sendMessage, deleteMessage, downloadFile },
      supabase: {
        from: vi.fn((table: string) =>
          table === "telegram_users_qll" ? { upsert } : { insert }
        ),
      } as unknown as SupabaseClient,
      relayEnabled: true,
    };

    const done = handleUpdate(sensitiveReply(), deps);

    // The upstream send is slow (900ms, i.e. already past any 500ms window);
    // no delete may happen yet because delivery is not confirmed.
    await vi.advanceTimersByTimeAsync(900);
    expect(trace).toEqual([`send:${QLL_ID}`]);
    expect(deleteMessage).not.toHaveBeenCalled();

    // Delivery confirms. From this instant, the delete must be issued without
    // advancing the clock at all (prompt, same invocation).
    const confirmAt = Date.now();
    resolveSend?.({ ok: true, messageId: 2 });
    await vi.advanceTimersByTimeAsync(0); // drain microtasks only, 0ms elapsed
    await done;

    expect(trace[0]).toBe(`send:${QLL_ID}`);
    expect(trace[1]).toBe(`delete:${GROUP_ID}:${REPLY_MSG_ID}`);
    expect(deleteMessage).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
    // Elapsed time from delivery confirmation to the delete call is zero â€”
    // the delete is NOT blocked behind the remaining 10s timeout budget.
    expect(times.delete! - confirmAt).toBe(0);
  });
});

describe("handleUpdate â€” ignore branches", () => {
  it("ignores a group message that is not a reply (no relay side effects)", async () => {
    const { deps, sendMessage, deleteMessage, insert, upsert } = makeDeps({});
    await handleUpdate(
      {
        update_id: 2,
        message: {
          message_id: 1,
          date: 1_700_000_000,
          chat: { id: GROUP_ID, type: "supergroup" },
          from: { id: 1, first_name: "X" },
          text: "TK: 12345678",
        },
      },
      deps
    );
    // No relay actions on a non-reply message...
    expect(sendMessage).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    expect(deleteMessage).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    expect(insert).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    // ...but the sender is still collected into telegram_users_qll.
    expect(upsert).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
  });

  it("ignores a group reply that is not sensitive (no relay side effects)", async () => {
    const { deps, sendMessage, deleteMessage, insert, upsert } = makeDeps({});
    const update = sensitiveReply("ChĂ o báº¡n nhĂ©");
    await handleUpdate(update, deps);
    // No relay actions on a non-sensitive reply...
    expect(sendMessage).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    expect(deleteMessage).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    expect(insert).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    // ...but the replier is still collected.
    expect(upsert).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
  });
});

describe("handleUpdate â€” auto-ack reply to an HS announcement", () => {
  const ACK = "Dáº¡ em ghi nháº­n chuyá»ƒn anh/chá»‹ bĂªn em kiá»ƒm tra nha áº¡.";
  const ADMIN_ID = 6532155675;

  function replyToBot(opts: {
    repliedText: string;
    repliedIsBot: boolean;
    replierIsBot?: boolean;
    chatType?: "supergroup" | "private";
  }): TelegramUpdate {
    return {
      update_id: 70,
      message: {
        message_id: 777,
        date: 1_700_000_000,
        chat: { id: GROUP_ID, type: opts.chatType ?? "supergroup" },
        from: { id: 555, first_name: "QLL", is_bot: opts.replierIsBot ?? false },
        text: "ok em",
        reply_to_message: {
          message_id: 400,
          date: 1_700_000_000,
          chat: { id: GROUP_ID, type: opts.chatType ?? "supergroup" },
          from: { id: 999, first_name: "Bot", is_bot: opts.repliedIsBot },
          text: opts.repliedText,
        },
      },
    };
  }

  it("acks when a user replies to a bot HS announcement", async () => {
    const { deps, sendMessage } = makeDeps({ relayEnabled: false });
    await handleUpdate(
      replyToBot({
        repliedText:
          "âœ… ThĂ´ng tin há»c cá»§a con #KHTN\n\n1. HS A\n   â€¢ MĂ£ lá»›p: KHTN.2026.0001",
        repliedIsBot: true,
      }),
      deps
    );
    // 1) Public ack to the group as a reply (3rd arg = replier's message_id).
    expect(sendMessage).toHaveBeenNthCalledWith(1, GROUP_ID, ACK, 777);
    // 2) Private notice to the admin with who/what/excerpt.
    const adminCall = sendMessage.mock.calls.find((c) => c[0] === ADMIN_ID);
    expect(adminCall).toBeDefined();
    expect(adminCall![1]).toContain("QLL pháº£n há»“i thĂ´ng bĂ¡o");
    expect(adminCall![1]).toContain("ok em"); // the replier's text
  });

  it("does NOT ack a reply to a non-announcement bot message", async () => {
    const { deps, sendMessage } = makeDeps({ relayEnabled: false });
    await handleUpdate(
      replyToBot({ repliedText: "âœ… ÄĂ£ gá»­i xong toĂ n bá»™ danh sĂ¡ch.", repliedIsBot: true }),
      deps
    );
    expect(sendMessage).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });

  it("does NOT ack a reply to a human message (not a bot)", async () => {
    const { deps, sendMessage } = makeDeps({ relayEnabled: false });
    await handleUpdate(
      replyToBot({
        repliedText: "âœ… ThĂ´ng tin há»c cá»§a con #KHTN",
        repliedIsBot: false,
      }),
      deps
    );
    expect(sendMessage).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });

  it("does NOT ack in a private chat", async () => {
    const { deps, sendMessage } = makeDeps({ relayEnabled: false });
    await handleUpdate(
      replyToBot({
        repliedText: "âœ… ThĂ´ng tin há»c cá»§a con #KHTN",
        repliedIsBot: true,
        chatType: "private",
      }),
      deps
    );
    expect(sendMessage).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });
});

describe("handleUpdate â€” /spam (operator DM -> post to fixed group)", () => {
  const ADMIN_ID = 6532155675;
  const TARGET_GROUP = -1002273179613;
  const EXPECTED_MESSAGE = [
    "âœ… ThĂ´ng tin há»c cá»§a con",
    "Há»c sinh: Nguyá»…n Äá»©c Minh",
    "Lá»‹ch há»c: T5 (20:30-21:30)",
    "Thá»i lÆ°á»£ng buá»•i há»c : 60 phĂºt",
    "NgĂ y tham gia lá»›p há»c: 15-10-2026",
    "MĂ£ lá»›p há»c: TCLC.2025.0207 Khá»‘i lá»›p: 3",
    "",
    "HS nay cĂ³ ca há»c QLL náº¯m thĂªm thĂ´ng tin trao Ä‘á»•i vá»›i PHHS lá»‹ch ná»¯a nhĂ© áº¡ ! @SA_AnhMTK",
  ].join("\n");

  // A private-chat /spam from the given user (chat.id == user id for DMs).
  function spamDm(fromId: number, text = "/spam"): TelegramUpdate {
    return {
      update_id: 50,
      message: {
        message_id: 1,
        date: 1_700_000_000,
        chat: { id: fromId, type: "private" },
        from: { id: fromId, first_name: "Operator" },
        text,
      },
    };
  }

  it("posts to the fixed target group and confirms privately when an operator DMs /spam", async () => {
    // relay stays OFF â€” /spam is independent of the relay switch.
    const { deps, sendMessage, deleteMessage, insert } = makeDeps({
      relayEnabled: false,
    });

    await handleUpdate(spamDm(ADMIN_ID), deps);

    // 1) announcement into the fixed group, 2) private confirmation.
    expect(sendMessage).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(2);
    expect(sendMessage).toHaveBeenNthCalledWith(1, TARGET_GROUP, EXPECTED_MESSAGE);
    expect(sendMessage).toHaveBeenNthCalledWith(
      2,
      ADMIN_ID,
      "âœ… ÄĂ£ gá»­i thĂ´ng bĂ¡o vĂ o nhĂ³m."
    );
    // Pure announcement: no deletes, no credential logging.
    expect(deleteMessage).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    expect(insert).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });

  it("ignores /spam from a non-authorized user (posts nothing)", async () => {
    const { deps, sendMessage } = makeDeps({ relayEnabled: false });
    await handleUpdate(spamDm(999999), deps);
    expect(sendMessage).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });

  it("ignores /spam sent inside a group (must be a private DM)", async () => {
    const { deps, sendMessage } = makeDeps({ relayEnabled: false });
    await handleUpdate(
      {
        update_id: 51,
        message: {
          message_id: 1,
          date: 1_700_000_000,
          chat: { id: GROUP_ID, type: "supergroup", title: "NhĂ³m QLL" },
          from: { id: ADMIN_ID, first_name: "Operator" },
          text: "/spam",
        },
      },
      deps
    );
    expect(sendMessage).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });

  it("still works when relay is enabled, without running the relay flow", async () => {
    const { deps, sendMessage, deleteMessage } = makeDeps({
      relayEnabled: true,
    });
    await handleUpdate(spamDm(ADMIN_ID), deps);
    expect(sendMessage).toHaveBeenNthCalledWith(1, TARGET_GROUP, EXPECTED_MESSAGE);
    expect(deleteMessage).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });
});

describe("handleUpdate â€” passive collection mode (relay disabled)", () => {
  it("collects the sender but performs NO relay action when relay is off", async () => {
    // Even a sensitive reply must not be deleted, relayed, or replied to while
    // relay is disabled â€” only the user is collected.
    const { deps, sendMessage, deleteMessage, insert, upsert } = makeDeps({
      relayEnabled: false,
    });

    await handleUpdate(sensitiveReply("TK: 0988573647 / MK: 0938347328"), deps);

    expect(sendMessage).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    expect(deleteMessage).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    expect(insert).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    // The CTV (message sender) is upserted into telegram_users_qll.
    expect(upsert).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
    expect(upsert.mock.calls[0][0]).toMatchObject({
      telegram_id: 222,
      username: null,
      full_name: "Minh CTV",
      chat_id: GROUP_ID,
    });
  });

  it("collects newly-joined members from new_chat_members", async () => {
    const { deps, upsert } = makeDeps({ relayEnabled: false });

    await handleUpdate(
      {
        update_id: 9,
        message: {
          message_id: 1,
          date: 1_700_000_000,
          chat: { id: GROUP_ID, type: "supergroup", title: "NhĂ³m QLL" },
          from: { id: 500, first_name: "Admin" },
          new_chat_members: [
            { id: 601, first_name: "An", username: "an_qll" },
            { id: 602, first_name: "BĂ¬nh", last_name: "Tráº§n" },
            { id: 999, is_bot: true, first_name: "SomeBot" },
          ],
        },
      },
      deps
    );

    // Admin (sender) + An + BĂ¬nh are collected; the bot member is skipped.
    const ids = upsert.mock.calls.map((c) => (c[0] as { telegram_id: number }).telegram_id);
    expect(ids.sort()).toEqual([500, 601, 602]);
    // Chat title is captured.
    expect(upsert.mock.calls[0][0]).toMatchObject({ chat_title: "NhĂ³m QLL" });
  });

  it("does NOT collect users from a private chat", async () => {
    const { deps, upsert, sendMessage } = makeDeps({ relayEnabled: false });

    await handleUpdate(
      {
        update_id: 10,
        message: {
          message_id: 1,
          date: 1_700_000_000,
          chat: { id: QLL_ID, type: "private" },
          from: { id: QLL_ID, first_name: "Boss" },
          text: "/start",
        },
      },
      deps
    );

    // Private chat is out of scope for collection, and relay is off so no ack.
    expect(upsert).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    expect(sendMessage).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });
});

  function makeXlsx(rows: unknown[][]): Buffer {

  }

      },
    ];
    const { deps, sendMessage, sendQueueInsert } = makeDeps({
      relayEnabled: false,
      pendingItems: items,
    });

    await handleUpdate(textDm(ADMIN_ID, "/ok"), deps);

    // THREE rows: SA_X splits by subject (KHTN, TOAN) + SA_Y (MOET).
    // A QLL is NEVER tagged for two subjects in one message.
    expect(sendQueueInsert).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
    const enqueued = sendQueueInsert.mock.calls[0][0] as {
      chat_id: number;
      message_text: string;
      send_after: string | null;
    }[];
    expect(enqueued).toHaveLength(3);

    const texts = enqueued.map((r) => r.message_text);
    // SA_X has a KHTN-only message (HS Má»™t) and a separate TOAN-only message
    // (HS Hai) â€” never both subjects in one message.
    const khtnX = texts.find((t) => t.includes("1. HS Má»™t"));
    const toanX = texts.find((t) => t.includes("1. HS Hai"));
    const moetY = texts.find((t) => t.includes("1. HS Ba"));
    expect(khtnX).toBeDefined();
    expect(toanX).toBeDefined();
    expect(moetY).toBeDefined();

    // Each message is single-subject (one hashtag only) and tags its QLL once.
    expect(khtnX).toContain("#KHTN");
    expect(khtnX).not.toContain("#TOAN");
    expect(khtnX!.match(/@SA_X/g)).toHaveLength(1);

    expect(toanX).toContain("#TOAN");
    expect(toanX).not.toContain("#KHTN");
    expect(toanX!.match(/@SA_X/g)).toHaveLength(1);

    expect(moetY).toContain("#MOET");
    expect(moetY!.match(/@SA_Y/g)).toHaveLength(1);

    // All go to the fixed target group.
    enqueued.forEach((r) => expect(r.chat_id).toBe(TARGET_GROUP));

    expect(sendMessage).toHaveBeenCalledWith(
      ADMIN_ID,
      "âœ… ÄĂ£ xáº¿p 3 tin vĂ o hĂ ng Ä‘á»£i. Bot sáº½ gá»­i ráº£i ~15-20s/tin, sáº½ bĂ¡o láº¡i khi xong."
    );
  });

  it("/ok with no pending batch replies 'KhĂ´ng cĂ³ danh sĂ¡ch nĂ o Ä‘ang chá».' and posts nothing", async () => {
    const { deps, sendMessage } = makeDeps({
      relayEnabled: false,
      pendingItems: null,
    });
    await handleUpdate(textDm(ADMIN_ID, "/ok"), deps);
    expect(sendMessage).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
    expect(sendMessage).toHaveBeenCalledWith(
      ADMIN_ID,
      "KhĂ´ng cĂ³ danh sĂ¡ch nĂ o Ä‘ang chá»."
    );
  });

  it("/huy deletes the pending batch and confirms (not swallowed by the /ok branch)", async () => {

    });

    expect(reply[1]).toContain("ÄĂ£ huá»· 3 tin");

  it("/cancel from a non-admin is ignored", async () => {

    });

    expect(sendQueueDelete).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    expect(sendMessage).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });

  it("ignores a document from a non-admin private chat", async () => {
    const { deps, sendMessage, downloadFile } = makeDeps({
      relayEnabled: false,
      downloadResult: { ok: true, buffer: makeXlsx([]) },
    });
    await handleUpdate(docDm(999999), deps);
    expect(downloadFile).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    expect(sendMessage).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });

  it("ignores a document sent in a group (still passively collects the sender)", async () => {
    const { deps, sendMessage, downloadFile, upsert } = makeDeps({
      relayEnabled: false,

    await handleUpdate(

          date: 1_700_000_000,
          chat: { id: GROUP_ID, type: "supergroup", title: "NhĂ³m QLL" },
          from: { id: ADMIN_ID, first_name: "Operator" },

    expect(downloadFile).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    expect(sendMessage).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    // Group document still triggers passive collection of the sender.
    expect(upsert).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
  });

  it("reports a download failure privately and posts nothing to the group", async () => {
    const { deps, sendMessage, pendingUpsert } = makeDeps({
      relayEnabled: false,
      downloadResult: { ok: false, description: "boom" },

    await handleUpdate(docDm(ADMIN_ID), deps);

    expect(sendMessage.mock.calls[0][0]).toBe(ADMIN_ID);
    expect(pendingUpsert).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });

import { afterEach, beforeEach, describe, expect, it, vi } from "vitest";
import type { VercelRequest, VercelResponse } from "@vercel/node";

// Mock only the external edges: Supabase client and native fetch. The webhook,
// handler, detector, telegram wrapper, config, and mapping all run for real.
const insert = vi.fn(async (_record: { status: string }) => ({ error: null }));
const upsert = vi.fn(async (_record: { telegram_id: number }) => ({ error: null }));
const supabaseFrom = vi.fn((table: string) =>
  table === "telegram_users_qll" ? { upsert } : { insert }
);
vi.mock("../lib/supabase.js", async (importOriginal) => {
  const actual = await importOriginal<typeof import("../lib/supabase.js")>();
  return {
    ...actual,
    getClient: vi.fn(() => ({ from: supabaseFrom })),
  };
});

const { default: handler } = await import("../api/webhook.js");

function mockRes(): VercelResponse & { statusCode: number; body: unknown } {
  const res = {
    statusCode: 0,
    body: undefined as unknown,
    status(code: number) {
      this.statusCode = code;
      return this;
    },
    json(payload: unknown) {
      this.body = payload;
      return this;
    },
  };
  return res as unknown as VercelResponse & {
    statusCode: number;
    body: unknown;
  };
}

const GROUP_ID = -1001;
const QLL_ID = 111;

function sensitiveUpdate() {
  return {
    update_id: 1,
    message: {
      message_id: 500,
      date: 1_700_000_100,
      chat: { id: GROUP_ID, type: "supergroup" },
      from: { id: 222, first_name: "Minh", last_name: "CTV" },
      text: "TK: user / MK: pass",
      reply_to_message: {
        message_id: 400,
        date: 1_700_000_000,
        chat: { id: GROUP_ID, type: "supergroup" },
        from: { id: QLL_ID, first_name: "Boss", last_name: "QLL" },
        text: "Cho mĂ¬nh xin tĂ i khoáº£n",
      },
    },
  };
}

// Builds a fetch mock whose response depends on the Telegram method called.
function stubFetch(sendPayload: unknown): ReturnType<typeof vi.fn> {
  const spy = vi.fn(async (url: string, _init?: RequestInit) => {
    if (url.includes("/sendMessage")) {
      return { json: async () => sendPayload };
    }
    // deleteMessage
    return { json: async () => ({ ok: true }) };
  });
  vi.stubGlobal("fetch", spy as unknown as typeof fetch);
  return spy;
}

describe("integration: api/webhook end-to-end", () => {
  beforeEach(() => {
    process.env.BOT_TOKEN = "test-token";
    process.env.SUPABASE_URL = "https://example.supabase.co";
    process.env.SUPABASE_KEY = "test-key";
    // These end-to-end cases exercise the relay flow, so enable it explicitly.
    process.env.RELAY_ENABLED = "true";
  });

  afterEach(() => {
    vi.unstubAllGlobals();
    vi.clearAllMocks();
    delete process.env.BOT_TOKEN;
    delete process.env.SUPABASE_URL;
    delete process.env.SUPABASE_KEY;
    delete process.env.RELAY_ENABLED;
  });

  it("happy path: relays, deletes, logs, confirms and returns 200", async () => {
    const fetchSpy = stubFetch({ ok: true, result: { message_id: 9 } });
    const res = mockRes();

    await handler(
      { body: sensitiveUpdate() } as unknown as VercelRequest,
      res
    );

    expect(res.statusCode).toBe(200);

    const calls = fetchSpy.mock.calls.map((c) => String(c[0]));
    // Inbox send, then delete, then group confirmation.
    expect(calls[0]).toContain("/sendMessage");
    expect(calls[1]).toContain("/deleteMessage");
    expect(calls[2]).toContain("/sendMessage");

    const confirmBody = JSON.parse(
      (fetchSpy.mock.calls[2][1] as RequestInit).body as string
    );
    expect(confirmBody.text).toBe(
      "đŸ”’ Em Ä‘Ă£ gá»­i tin nháº¯n cho mĂ¬nh rá»“i áº¡. Anh/chá»‹ kiá»ƒm tra tin nháº¯n nha áº¡"
    );

    expect(supabaseFrom).toHaveBeenCalledWith("bot_account_logs");
    expect(insert.mock.calls[0][0]).toMatchObject({ status: "ÄĂ£ gá»­i Inbox" });
  });

  it("403 path: deletes first, logs 'Lá»—i chÆ°a start bot', warns and returns 200", async () => {
    const fetchSpy = stubFetch({
      ok: false,
      error_code: 403,
      description: "Forbidden",
    });
    const res = mockRes();

    await handler(
      { body: sensitiveUpdate() } as unknown as VercelRequest,
      res
    );

    expect(res.statusCode).toBe(200);

    const calls = fetchSpy.mock.calls.map((c) => String(c[0]));
    expect(calls[0]).toContain("/sendMessage"); // inbox attempt
    expect(calls[1]).toContain("/deleteMessage"); // delete FIRST
    expect(calls[2]).toContain("/sendMessage"); // warning

    const warnBody = JSON.parse(
      (fetchSpy.mock.calls[2][1] as RequestInit).body as string
    );
    expect(warnBody.text).toBe(
      "â ï¸ ÄĂ£ áº©n thĂ´ng tin! QLL cáº§n báº¥m /start á»Ÿ khung chat riĂªng vá»›i Bot Ä‘á»ƒ nháº­n Inbox."
    );

import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest";
import { buildLogRecord, displayName } from "../lib/mapping.js";
import type { TelegramMessage } from "../lib/types.js";

describe("displayName", () => {
  it("returns first + last when both present", () => {
    expect(displayName({ id: 1, first_name: "Nguyen", last_name: "An" })).toBe(
      "Nguyen An"
    );
  });

  it("returns first only when last is absent", () => {
    expect(displayName({ id: 1, first_name: "Nguyen" })).toBe("Nguyen");
  });

  it("falls back to username when no names present", () => {
    expect(displayName({ id: 1, username: "nguyenan" })).toBe("nguyenan");
  });

  it("returns empty string when nothing is present", () => {
    expect(displayName({ id: 1 })).toBe("");
  });
});

describe("buildLogRecord", () => {
  const baseMessage: TelegramMessage = {
    message_id: 200,
    date: 1_700_000_100,
    chat: { id: -100, type: "supergroup" },
    from: { id: 2, first_name: "CTV", last_name: "User" },
    text: "TK: user / MK: pass",
    reply_to_message: {
      message_id: 100,
      date: 1_700_000_000,
      chat: { id: -100, type: "supergroup" },
      from: { id: 1, first_name: "QLL", last_name: "Boss" },
      text: "Cho mĂ¬nh xin tĂ i khoáº£n",
    },
  };

  it("maps all fields from message and reply_to_message", () => {
    const record = buildLogRecord(baseMessage, "ÄĂ£ gá»­i Inbox");
    expect(record).toEqual({
      created_at: new Date(1_700_000_000 * 1000).toISOString(),
      qll_telegram_id: "1",
      qll_name: "QLL Boss",
      request_content: "Cho mĂ¬nh xin tĂ i khoáº£n",
      ctv_name: "CTV User",
      response_content: "TK: user / MK: pass",
      status: "ÄĂ£ gá»­i Inbox",
    });
  });

  it("sets created_at to the reply_to_message timestamp as ISO UTC", () => {
    const record = buildLogRecord(baseMessage, "ÄĂ£ gá»­i Inbox");
    expect(record.created_at).toBe("2023-11-14T22:13:20.000Z");
  });

  it("uses empty string when the replied-to message has no text", () => {
    const msg: TelegramMessage = {
      ...baseMessage,
      reply_to_message: {
        ...baseMessage.reply_to_message!,
        text: undefined,
      },
    };
    expect(buildLogRecord(msg, "ÄĂ£ gá»­i Inbox").request_content).toBe("");
  });

  it("preserves an explicit empty-string replied-to text as ''", () => {
    const msg: TelegramMessage = {
      ...baseMessage,
      reply_to_message: {
        ...baseMessage.reply_to_message!,
        text: "",
      },
    };
    expect(buildLogRecord(msg, "ÄĂ£ gá»­i Inbox").request_content).toBe("");
  });

  it("falls back to username in qll_name / ctv_name", () => {
    const msg: TelegramMessage = {
      ...baseMessage,
      from: { id: 2, username: "ctvuser" },
      reply_to_message: {
        ...baseMessage.reply_to_message!,
        from: { id: 1, username: "qlluser" },
      },
    };
    const record = buildLogRecord(msg, "ÄĂ£ gá»­i Inbox");
    expect(record.qll_name).toBe("qlluser");
    expect(record.ctv_name).toBe("ctvuser");
  });
});

import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest";
import {
  mapQll,
  mapQllByUser,
  nameToCore,
  normalize,
  usernameToCore,
  type KnownUser,
} from "../lib/qllmap.js";

// The fixed known-username list used across the mapping assertions. Mirrors a
// snapshot of telegram_users_qll's `username` column.
const KNOWN = [
  "SA_PhuongLTT3",
  "SA_LanNT18",
  "SAAnhPTH5",
  "SA_NgaNT23",
  "SA_NgocNT22",
  "SA_HaNH3",
  "OP_HuyNQ5",
];

describe("normalize", () => {
  it("strips diacritics and lowercases", () => {
    expect(normalize("Nguyá»…n")).toBe("nguyen");
    expect(normalize("PhÆ°Æ¡ng")).toBe("phuong");
  });

  it("maps Ä‘/Ä to d", () => {
    expect(normalize("Äáº·ng")).toBe("dang");
    expect(normalize("Ä‘á»")).toBe("do");
  });

  it("removes non [a-z0-9] characters", () => {
    expect(normalize("A n-h_5!")).toBe("anh5");
  });
});

describe("nameToCore", () => {
  it("builds the worked example core", () => {
    // "Nguyá»…n Háº£i HĂ  3": TĂªn "HĂ "->"ha", initials "NH"->"nh", number "3".
    expect(nameToCore("Nguyá»…n Háº£i HĂ  3")).toBe("hanh3");
  });

  it("handles a name with no trailing number", () => {
    // TĂªn "HĂ "->"ha", initials "NH"->"nh", no number.
    expect(nameToCore("Nguyá»…n Háº£i HĂ ")).toBe("hanh");
  });

  it("handles a compound (multi-word) family part", () => {
    expect(nameToCore("LÆ°u Thá»‹ Thu PhÆ°Æ¡ng 3")).toBe("phuongltt3");
  });

  it("handles a single-token name (no family words)", () => {
    expect(nameToCore("HĂ  7")).toBe("ha7");
    expect(nameToCore("HĂ ")).toBe("ha");
  });

  it("returns empty for an empty string", () => {
    expect(nameToCore("")).toBe("");
    expect(nameToCore("   ")).toBe("");
  });
});

describe("usernameToCore", () => {
  it("strips SA_ prefix", () => {
    expect(usernameToCore("SA_HaNH3")).toBe("hanh3");
  });

  it("strips a prefix with no underscore", () => {
    expect(usernameToCore("SAAnhPTH5")).toBe("anhpth5");
  });

  it("strips OP and VH prefixes", () => {
    expect(usernameToCore("OP_HuyNQ5")).toBe("huynq5");
    expect(usernameToCore("VH_LanNT18")).toBe("lannt18");
  });

  it("normalizes a username with no role prefix", () => {
    expect(usernameToCore("HaNH3")).toBe("hanh3");
  });
});

describe("mapQll â€” verified real pairs", () => {
  const pairs: [string, string][] = [
    ["LÆ°u Thá»‹ Thu PhÆ°Æ¡ng 3", "SA_PhuongLTT3"],
    ["NĂ´ng Thá»‹ Lan 18", "SA_LanNT18"],
    ["Pháº¡m Thá»‹ Háº£i Anh 5", "SAAnhPTH5"],
    ["Nguyá»…n Thá»‹ Nga 23", "SA_NgaNT23"],
    ["Nguyá»…n Thá»‹ Ngá»c 22", "SA_NgocNT22"],
    ["Nguyá»…n Háº£i HĂ  3", "SA_HaNH3"],
  ];

  for (const [name, username] of pairs) {
    it(`maps "${name}" -> ${username}`, () => {
      expect(mapQll(name, KNOWN)).toEqual({ kind: "found", username });
    });
  }
});

describe("mapQll â€” negative and ambiguous", () => {
  it("returns notFound for a name not in the known list", () => {
    expect(mapQll("Tráº§n VÄƒn Khoa 9", KNOWN)).toEqual({ kind: "notFound" });
  });

  it("returns notFound for a blank name", () => {
    expect(mapQll("", KNOWN)).toEqual({ kind: "notFound" });
  });

  it("returns ambiguous when two known usernames share a core", () => {
    // Both normalize to core "hanh3".
    const known = ["SA_HaNH3", "HaNH3"];
    const result = mapQll("Nguyá»…n Háº£i HĂ  3", known);
    expect(result).toEqual({
      kind: "ambiguous",
      candidates: ["SA_HaNH3", "HaNH3"],
    });
  });
});

describe("mapQllByUser â€” full-name match takes priority over the core rule", () => {
  const USERS: KnownUser[] = [
    // Registered manually: the username carries a trailing number ("86") the
    // name does not, so the derived-core rule alone would MISS this.
    { username: "SA_Uyennk86", full_name: "Nguyá»…n KhĂ¡nh UyĂªn" },
    { username: "SA_HaNH3", full_name: "Ha Nguyen" },
  ];

  it("maps a registered full name to its username even when the core rule misses", () => {
    expect(mapQllByUser("Nguyá»…n KhĂ¡nh UyĂªn", USERS)).toEqual({
      kind: "found",
      username: "SA_Uyennk86",
    });
  });

  it("matches the full name case- and diacritic-insensitively", () => {
    expect(mapQllByUser("nguyen khanh uyen", USERS)).toEqual({
      kind: "found",
      username: "SA_Uyennk86",
    });
  });

  it("falls back to the derived-core rule when no full name matches", () => {
    // "Nguyá»…n Háº£i HĂ  3" has no full_name hit here (stored as "Ha Nguyen"),
    // so the core rule resolves it to SA_HaNH3 (core "hanh3").
    expect(mapQllByUser("Nguyá»…n Háº£i HĂ  3", USERS)).toEqual({
      kind: "found",
      username: "SA_HaNH3",
    });
  });

  it("returns notFound when neither full name nor core matches", () => {
    expect(mapQllByUser("Tráº§n VÄƒn Láº¡ 9", USERS)).toEqual({ kind: "notFound" });
  });
});



=== FILE: tests\schedule.test.ts ===
import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest";
import { formatVnDateTime, parseOkCommand } from "../lib/schedule.js";

// A fixed "now" at 2025-06-15T03:00:00.000Z = 10:00 VN on 15 Jun 2025.
const NOW = new Date("2025-06-15T03:00:00.000Z");

describe("parseOkCommand â€” immediate /ok", () => {
  it("treats exact /ok as send-now", () => {
    expect(parseOkCommand("/ok", NOW)).toEqual({ kind: "now" });
  });

  it("is case-insensitive (/OK)", () => {
    expect(parseOkCommand("/OK", NOW)).toEqual({ kind: "now" });
  });

  it("tolerates trailing/leading whitespace", () => {
    expect(parseOkCommand("/ok   ", NOW)).toEqual({ kind: "now" });
    expect(parseOkCommand("  /ok  ", NOW)).toEqual({ kind: "now" });
  });
});

describe("parseOkCommand â€” HH:MM scheduling", () => {
  it("21:00 VN today -> 14:00 UTC same day (explicit âˆ’7h offset)", () => {
    const result = parseOkCommand("/ok 21:00", NOW);
    expect(result).toEqual({
      kind: "at",
      sendAfterIso: "2025-06-15T14:00:00.000Z",
    });
  });

  it("rolls to tomorrow VN when the time already passed today", () => {
    // 10:00 VN now; 05:00 VN today already passed -> tomorrow.
    const result = parseOkCommand("/ok 05:00", NOW);
    // 05:00 VN on 16 Jun = 22:00 UTC on 15 Jun (previous UTC calendar day),
    // proving Date.UTC + ms rollover works across the midnight boundary.
    expect(result).toEqual({
      kind: "at",
      sendAfterIso: "2025-06-15T22:00:00.000Z",
    });
  });

  it("accepts a single-digit hour (9:30 VN already passed -> tomorrow)", () => {
    // 9:30 VN = 02:30 UTC, before NOW (03:00 UTC), so it rolls to tomorrow VN.
    const result = parseOkCommand("/ok 9:30", NOW);
    expect(result).toEqual({
      kind: "at",
      sendAfterIso: "2025-06-16T02:30:00.000Z",
    });
  });
});

describe("parseOkCommand â€” dd/mm HH:MM scheduling", () => {
  it("16/10 21:00 later this VN year -> current-year 14:00 UTC", () => {
    const result = parseOkCommand("/ok 16/10 21:00", NOW);
    expect(result).toEqual({
      kind: "at",
      sendAfterIso: "2025-10-16T14:00:00.000Z",
    });
  });

  it("rolls to next year when the dated instant already passed", () => {
    // 01/01 00:00 of 2025 is long past relative to NOW -> 2026.
    const result = parseOkCommand("/ok 1/1 00:00", NOW);
    expect(result).toEqual({
      kind: "at",
      sendAfterIso: "2025-12-31T17:00:00.000Z",
    });
  });

  it("tolerates extra internal whitespace", () => {
    const result = parseOkCommand("/ok   16/10   21:00", NOW);
    expect(result).toEqual({
      kind: "at",
      sendAfterIso: "2025-10-16T14:00:00.000Z",
    });
  });
});

describe("parseOkCommand â€” invalid inputs", () => {
  for (const bad of [
    "/ok abc",
    "/ok 9pm",
    "/ok 25:00",
    "/ok 21:60",
    "/ok 32/10 21:00",
    "/ok 16/13 21:00",
    "/ok 0/5 10:00",
  ]) {
    it(`rejects ${JSON.stringify(bad)}`, () => {
      const result = parseOkCommand(bad, NOW);
      expect(result.kind).toBe("invalid");
      if (result.kind === "invalid") {
        expect(result.reason.length).toBeGreaterThan(0);
      }
    });
  }
});

describe("formatVnDateTime", () => {
  it("renders a UTC instant as HH:MM dd/mm in VN time", () => {
    expect(formatVnDateTime("2025-06-15T14:00:00.000Z")).toBe("21:00 15/06");
  });

  it("rolls the VN date forward past midnight UTC", () => {
    // 22:00 UTC + 7h = 05:00 next day VN.
    expect(formatVnDateTime("2025-06-15T22:00:00.000Z")).toBe("05:00 16/06");
  });
});

import { describe, expect, it, vi } from "vitest";
import type { SupabaseClient } from "@supabase/supabase-js";
import {
  countUnsent,
  enqueueMessages,
  fetchNextUnsent,
  markSent,
} from "../lib/supabase.js";
import type { SendQueueRow } from "../lib/types.js";

const ADMIN_ID = 6532155675;
const TARGET_GROUP = -1002273179613;

const ROWS = [
  { admin_id: ADMIN_ID, chat_id: TARGET_GROUP, message_text: "A" },
  { admin_id: ADMIN_ID, chat_id: TARGET_GROUP, message_text: "B" },
];

describe("enqueueMessages", () => {
  it("inserts the rows into send_queue and returns { ok: true }", async () => {
    const insert = vi.fn(async () => ({ error: null }));
    const from = vi.fn(() => ({ insert }));
    const client = { from } as unknown as SupabaseClient;

    const result = await enqueueMessages(client, ROWS);
    expect(result).toEqual({ ok: true });
    expect(from).toHaveBeenCalledWith("send_queue");
    expect(insert).toHaveBeenCalledWith(ROWS);
  });

  it("short-circuits to { ok: true } on an empty array without inserting", async () => {
    const insert = vi.fn(async () => ({ error: null }));
    const from = vi.fn(() => ({ insert }));
    const client = { from } as unknown as SupabaseClient;

    expect(await enqueueMessages(client, [])).toEqual({ ok: true });
    expect(from).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    expect(insert).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });

  it("returns { ok: false } on a Supabase error without throwing", async () => {
    const insert = vi.fn(async () => ({ error: { message: "insert failed" } }));
    const from = vi.fn(() => ({ insert }));
    const client = { from } as unknown as SupabaseClient;

    expect(await enqueueMessages(client, ROWS)).toEqual({
      ok: false,
      error: "insert failed",
    });
  });
});

describe("fetchNextUnsent", () => {
  // Chain: select -> eq(sent,false) -> or(due-filter) -> order -> limit.
  function buildClient(result: { data: unknown; error: unknown }) {
    const limit = vi.fn(async () => result);
    const order = vi.fn(() => ({ limit }));
    const or = vi.fn((_filter: string) => ({ order }));
    const eq = vi.fn(() => ({ or }));
    const select = vi.fn(() => ({ eq }));
    const from = vi.fn(() => ({ select }));
    return {
      client: { from } as unknown as SupabaseClient,
      from,
      select,
      eq,
      or,
      order,
      limit,
    };
  }

  it("selects due unsent rows ordered by created_at ascending with the limit", async () => {
    const rows: SendQueueRow[] = [
      { id: "1", admin_id: ADMIN_ID, chat_id: TARGET_GROUP, message_text: "A" },
      { id: "2", admin_id: ADMIN_ID, chat_id: TARGET_GROUP, message_text: "B" },
    ];
    const { client, from, select, eq, or, order, limit } = buildClient({
      data: rows,
      error: null,
    });

    const result = await fetchNextUnsent(client, 3);
    expect(result).toEqual({ ok: true, rows });
    expect(from).toHaveBeenCalledWith("send_queue");
    expect(select).toHaveBeenCalledWith("id, admin_id, chat_id, message_text");
    expect(eq).toHaveBeenCalledWith("sent", false);
    // Due filter: no schedule OR the scheduled time already arrived.
    expect(or).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
    const orArg = or.mock.calls[0][0];
    expect(orArg.startsWith("send_after.is.null,send_after.lte.")).toBe(true);
    expect(order).toHaveBeenCalledWith("created_at", { ascending: true });
    expect(limit).toHaveBeenCalledWith(3);
  });

  it("coalesces null data to an empty rows array", async () => {
    const { client } = buildClient({ data: null, error: null });
    expect(await fetchNextUnsent(client, 3)).toEqual({ ok: true, rows: [] });
  });

  it("returns { ok: false, rows: [] } on error without throwing", async () => {
    const { client } = buildClient({
      data: null,
      error: { message: "select failed" },
    });
    expect(await fetchNextUnsent(client, 3)).toEqual({
      ok: false,
      rows: [],
      error: "select failed",
    });
  });
});

describe("markSent", () => {
  function buildClient(result: { error: unknown }) {
    const eq = vi.fn(async () => result);
    const update = vi.fn((_payload: { sent: boolean; sent_at: string }) => ({
      eq,
    }));
    const from = vi.fn(() => ({ update }));
    return {
      client: { from } as unknown as SupabaseClient,
      from,
      update,
      eq,
    };
  }

  it("updates sent=true + sent_at where id matches", async () => {
    const { client, from, update, eq } = buildClient({ error: null });
    const result = await markSent(client, "row-1");
    expect(result).toEqual({ ok: true });
    expect(from).toHaveBeenCalledWith("send_queue");
    const payload = update.mock.calls[0][0];
    expect(payload.sent).toBe(true);
    expect(typeof payload.sent_at).toBe("string");
    expect(eq).toHaveBeenCalledWith("id", "row-1");
  });

  it("returns { ok: false } on error without throwing", async () => {
    const { client } = buildClient({ error: { message: "update failed" } });
    expect(await markSent(client, "row-1")).toEqual({
      ok: false,
      error: "update failed",
    });
  });
});

describe("countUnsent", () => {
  // The query chain is select -> eq(sent) and, when adminId is given, a second
  // eq(admin_id). The LAST eq in the chain must be awaitable (returns the
  // { count, error } result) AND still chainable for the admin filter case.
  function buildClient(result: { count: unknown; error: unknown }) {
    const eqSpy = vi.fn();
    const makeEq = () => {
      const eq = (...args: unknown[]) => {
        eqSpy(...args);
        const thenable = {
          eq,
          then: (
            resolve: (v: { count: unknown; error: unknown }) => unknown
          ) => resolve(result),
        };
        return thenable;
      };
      return eq;
    };
    const select = vi.fn(() => ({ eq: makeEq() }));
    const from = vi.fn(() => ({ select }));
    return {
      client: { from } as unknown as SupabaseClient,
      from,
      select,
      eqSpy,
    };
  }

  it("counts unsent rows (no admin filter)", async () => {
    const { client, from, select, eqSpy } = buildClient({
      count: 5,
      error: null,
    });
    const result = await countUnsent(client);
    expect(result).toEqual({ ok: true, count: 5 });
    expect(from).toHaveBeenCalledWith("send_queue");
    expect(select).toHaveBeenCalledWith("id", { count: "exact", head: true });
    expect(eqSpy).toHaveBeenCalledWith("sent", false);
    expect(eqSpy).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
  });

  it("adds an admin_id filter when adminId is provided", async () => {
    const { client, eqSpy } = buildClient({ count: 0, error: null });
    const result = await countUnsent(client, ADMIN_ID);
    expect(result).toEqual({ ok: true, count: 0 });
    expect(eqSpy).toHaveBeenCalledWith("sent", false);
    expect(eqSpy).toHaveBeenCalledWith("admin_id", ADMIN_ID);
  });

  it("coalesces a null count to 0", async () => {
    const { client } = buildClient({ count: null, error: null });
    expect(await countUnsent(client)).toEqual({ ok: true, count: 0 });
  });

  it("returns { ok: false, count: 0 } on error without throwing", async () => {
    const { client } = buildClient({
      count: null,
      error: { message: "count failed" },
    });
    expect(await countUnsent(client)).toEqual({
      ok: false,
      count: 0,
      error: "count failed",
    });
  });
});

describe("addUserManual", () => {
  // upsertUser now first SELECTs by username (ilike) to enforce one row per
  // username; buildClient returns an empty select (username not found) so the
  // code takes the INSERT/upsert path, then applies `result` to that upsert.
  function buildClient(result: { error: unknown }) {
    const upsert = vi.fn(async (_record: unknown, _opts: unknown) => result);
    const limit = vi.fn(async () => ({ data: [], error: null }));
    const ilike = vi.fn(() => ({ limit }));
    const select = vi.fn(() => ({ ilike }));
    const from = vi.fn(() => ({ select, upsert }));
    return { client: { from } as unknown as SupabaseClient, from, upsert };
  }

  const TARGET_CHAT_ID = -1002273179613;

  it("strips @, trims the name, sets chat_title 'manual' and a negative id", async () => {
    const { client, from, upsert } = buildClient({ error: null });
    const result = await addUserManual(
      client,
      "@SA_HaNH3",
      "  Nguyá»…n Háº£i HĂ  3  ",
      TARGET_CHAT_ID
    );
    expect(result).toEqual({ ok: true });
    expect(from).toHaveBeenCalledWith("telegram_users_qll");
    expect(upsert).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
    const record = upsert.mock.calls[0][0] as {
      telegram_id: number;
      username: string;
      full_name: string;
      chat_id: number;
      chat_title: string;
    };
    const opts = upsert.mock.calls[0][1];
    expect(opts).toEqual({ onConflict: "telegram_id" });
    expect(record).toMatchObject({
      username: "SA_HaNH3",
      full_name: "Nguyá»…n Háº£i HĂ  3",
      chat_id: TARGET_CHAT_ID,
      chat_title: "manual",
      telegram_id: manualUserId("SA_HaNH3"),
    });
    expect(record.telegram_id).toBeLessThan(0);
  });

  it("returns { ok: false } on a reported error without throwing", async () => {
    const { client } = buildClient({ error: { message: "upsert failed" } });
    expect(
      await addUserManual(client, "SA_HaNH3", "Nguyá»…n Háº£i HĂ  3", TARGET_CHAT_ID)
    ).toEqual({ ok: false, error: "upsert failed" });
  });

import { afterEach, describe, expect, it, vi } from "vitest";
import {
  createTelegramClient,
  deleteWithRetry,
  splitForTelegram,
  withTimeout,
  TimeoutError,
  type TelegramClient,
} from "../lib/telegram.js";

describe("splitForTelegram", () => {
  it("returns the text as a single chunk when under the limit", () => {
    expect(splitForTelegram("short", 100)).toEqual(["short"]);
  });

  it("splits on line boundaries without cutting a line in half", () => {
    const lines = Array.from({ length: 10 }, (_, i) => `line-${i}`);
    const text = lines.join("\n");
    const parts = splitForTelegram(text, 20);
    // Every chunk is within the limit, and no line is broken.
    for (const p of parts) {
      expect(p.length).toBeLessThanOrEqual(20);
    }
    // Rejoining all chunks line-wise recovers every original line in order.
    expect(parts.join("\n").split("\n")).toEqual(lines);
    expect(parts.length).toBeGreaterThan(1);
  });

  it("hard-splits a single over-long line as a last resort", () => {
    const parts = splitForTelegram("x".repeat(50), 20);
    expect(parts).toEqual(["x".repeat(20), "x".repeat(20), "x".repeat(10)]);
  });

  it("keeps a long real-world summary under 4096 per chunk", () => {
    const big = Array.from({ length: 90 }, (_, i) => `- HS ${i} -> @SA_User${i}`).join("\n");
    const parts = splitForTelegram(big);
    for (const p of parts) {
      expect(p.length).toBeLessThanOrEqual(4000);
    }
  });
});

function mockFetchOnce(payload: unknown): void {
  vi.stubGlobal(
    "fetch",
    vi.fn(async () => ({
      json: async () => payload,
    })) as unknown as typeof fetch
  );
}

describe("createTelegramClient.sendMessage", () => {
  afterEach(() => {
    vi.unstubAllGlobals();
  });

  it("classifies a successful send", async () => {
    mockFetchOnce({ ok: true, result: { message_id: 42 } });
    const client = createTelegramClient("token");
    const result = await client.sendMessage(1, "hi");
    expect(result).toEqual({ ok: true, messageId: 42 });
  });

  it("classifies a 403 as forbidden", async () => {
    mockFetchOnce({ ok: false, error_code: 403, description: "Forbidden" });
    const client = createTelegramClient("token");
    const result = await client.sendMessage(1, "hi");
    expect(result).toEqual({
      ok: false,
      forbidden: true,
      description: "Forbidden",
    });
  });

  it("classifies a non-403 failure as not forbidden", async () => {
    mockFetchOnce({ ok: false, error_code: 400, description: "Bad Request" });
    const client = createTelegramClient("token");
    const result = await client.sendMessage(1, "hi");
    expect(result).toEqual({
      ok: false,
      forbidden: false,
      description: "Bad Request",
    });
  });

  it("sends the exact text byte-for-byte", async () => {
    const spy = vi.fn(async (_url: string, _init?: RequestInit) => ({
      json: async () => ({ ok: true, result: { message_id: 1 } }),
    }));
    vi.stubGlobal("fetch", spy as unknown as typeof fetch);
    const client = createTelegramClient("token");
    await client.sendMessage(99, "TK: user / MK: pass");
    const body = JSON.parse((spy.mock.calls[0][1] as RequestInit).body as string);
    expect(body).toEqual({ chat_id: 99, text: "TK: user / MK: pass" });
  });

  it("includes reply_to_message_id when a reply target is given", async () => {
    const spy = vi.fn(async (_url: string, _init?: RequestInit) => ({
      json: async () => ({ ok: true, result: { message_id: 1 } }),
    }));
    vi.stubGlobal("fetch", spy as unknown as typeof fetch);
    const client = createTelegramClient("token");
    await client.sendMessage(42, "xong rá»“i nhĂ©", 400);
    const body = JSON.parse((spy.mock.calls[0][1] as RequestInit).body as string);
    expect(body).toEqual({
      chat_id: 42,
      text: "xong rá»“i nhĂ©",
      reply_to_message_id: 400,
      allow_sending_without_reply: true,
    });
  });

  it("omits reply fields when no reply target is given", async () => {
    const spy = vi.fn(async (_url: string, _init?: RequestInit) => ({
      json: async () => ({ ok: true, result: { message_id: 1 } }),
    }));
    vi.stubGlobal("fetch", spy as unknown as typeof fetch);
    const client = createTelegramClient("token");
    await client.sendMessage(42, "no reply");
    const body = JSON.parse((spy.mock.calls[0][1] as RequestInit).body as string);
    expect(body.reply_to_message_id).toBeUndefined();
    expect(body.allow_sending_without_reply).toBeUndefined();
  });
});

describe("createTelegramClient.deleteMessage", () => {
  afterEach(() => {
    vi.unstubAllGlobals();
  });

  it("classifies a successful delete", async () => {
    mockFetchOnce({ ok: true });

        throw new Error("ECONNRESET");
      }) as unknown as typeof fetch
    );
    const client = createTelegramClient("token");
    const result = await client.deleteMessage(1, 2);
    expect(result.ok).toBe(false);
    expect((result as { description: string }).description).toBe("ECONNRESET");
  });
});

describe("createTelegramClient.downloadFile", () => {
  afterEach(() => {
    vi.unstubAllGlobals();
  });

  it("resolves getFile then downloads the bytes from the file host", async () => {
    const bytes = new Uint8Array([1, 2, 3, 4]).buffer;
    const spy = vi
      .fn()
      .mockResolvedValueOnce({
        json: async () => ({
          ok: true,
          result: { file_path: "documents/x.xlsx" },
        }),
      })
      .mockResolvedValueOnce({
        arrayBuffer: async () => bytes,
      });
    vi.stubGlobal("fetch", spy as unknown as typeof fetch);

    const client = createTelegramClient("token");
    const result = await client.downloadFile("file-123");

    expect(result.ok).toBe(true);
    expect((result as { buffer: Buffer }).buffer).toEqual(
      Buffer.from([1, 2, 3, 4])
    );
    // First call hits getFile with the file_id; second hits the /file/bot host.
    expect(spy.mock.calls[0][0]).toBe(
      "https://api.telegram.org/bottoken/getFile?file_id=file-123"
    );
    expect(spy.mock.calls[1][0]).toBe(
      "https://api.telegram.org/file/bottoken/documents/x.xlsx"
    );
  });

  it("returns a structured failure when getFile reports not-ok", async () => {
    mockFetchOnce({ ok: false, description: "file not found" });
    const client = createTelegramClient("token");
    const result = await client.downloadFile("missing");
    expect(result).toEqual({ ok: false, description: "file not found" });
  });

  it("returns a structured failure when fetch rejects (no throw)", async () => {
    vi.stubGlobal(
      "fetch",
      vi.fn(async () => {
        throw new Error("ECONNRESET");
      }) as unknown as typeof fetch
    );
    const client = createTelegramClient("token");
    const result = await client.downloadFile("file-123");
    expect(result.ok).toBe(false);
    expect((result as { description: string }).description).toBe("ECONNRESET");
  });
});

describe("withTimeout", () => {
  it("resolves when the promise settles in time", async () => {
    await expect(withTimeout(Promise.resolve("ok"), 1000)).resolves.toBe("ok");
  });

  it("rejects with TimeoutError when the promise is too slow", async () => {
    vi.useFakeTimers();
    const slow = new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 5000));
    const guarded = withTimeout(slow, 10);
    const assertion = expect(guarded).rejects.toBeInstanceOf(TimeoutError);
    await vi.advanceTimersByTimeAsync(20);
    await assertion;
    vi.useRealTimers();
  });
});

describe("deleteWithRetry", () => {
  it("returns on the first successful attempt", async () => {
    const client: TelegramClient = {
      sendMessage: vi.fn(),
      deleteMessage: vi.fn(async () => ({ ok: true as const })),
      downloadFile: vi.fn(),
    };
    const result = await deleteWithRetry(client, 1, 2);
    expect(result).toEqual({ ok: true });
    expect(client.deleteMessage).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
  });

  it("stops after 3 attempts when deletes keep failing", async () => {
    const client: TelegramClient = {
      sendMessage: vi.fn(),
      deleteMessage: vi.fn(async () => ({
        ok: false as const,
        description: "fail",
      })),
      downloadFile: vi.fn(),
    };
    const result = await deleteWithRetry(client, 1, 2);
    expect(result).toEqual({ ok: false, description: "fail" });
    expect(client.deleteMessage).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(3);
  });

  it("retries until success within the attempt budget", async () => {
    const deleteMessage = vi
      .fn()
      .mockResolvedValueOnce({ ok: false, description: "fail" })
      .mockResolvedValueOnce({ ok: true });
    const client: TelegramClient = {
      sendMessage: vi.fn(),
      deleteMessage,
      downloadFile: vi.fn(),
    };
    const result = await deleteWithRetry(client, 1, 2);
    expect(result).toEqual({ ok: true });
    expect(deleteMessage).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(2);
  });

  it("recovers after a rejected attempt and still succeeds", async () => {
    const deleteMessage = vi
      .fn()
      .mockRejectedValueOnce(new Error("socket hang up"))
      .mockResolvedValueOnce({ ok: true });
    const client: TelegramClient = {
      sendMessage: vi.fn(),
      deleteMessage,
      downloadFile: vi.fn(),
    };
    const result = await deleteWithRetry(client, 1, 2);
    expect(result).toEqual({ ok: true });
    expect(deleteMessage).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(2);
  });

  it("stops after 3 rejected attempts and returns a structured failure", async () => {
    const deleteMessage = vi
      .fn()
      .mockRejectedValue(new Error("socket hang up"));
    const client: TelegramClient = {
      sendMessage: vi.fn(),
      deleteMessage,
      downloadFile: vi.fn(),
    };
    const result = await deleteWithRetry(client, 1, 2);
    expect(result.ok).toBe(false);
    expect((result as { description: string }).description).toBe("socket hang up");
    expect(deleteMessage).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(3);
  });
});

import { afterEach, describe, expect, it, vi } from "vitest";
import type { VercelRequest, VercelResponse } from "@vercel/node";

const loadConfig = vi.fn();
const handleUpdate = vi.fn();
const createTelegramClient = vi.fn(() => ({}));
const getClient = vi.fn(() => ({}));

vi.mock("../lib/config.js", () => ({ loadConfig }));
vi.mock("../lib/handler.js", () => ({ handleUpdate }));
vi.mock("../lib/telegram.js", () => ({ createTelegramClient }));
vi.mock("../lib/supabase.js", () => ({ getClient }));

const { default: handler } = await import("../api/webhook.js");

function mockRes(): VercelResponse & {
  statusCode: number;
  body: unknown;
} {
  const res = {
    statusCode: 0,
    body: undefined as unknown,
    status(code: number) {
      this.statusCode = code;
      return this;
    },
    json(payload: unknown) {
      this.body = payload;
      return this;
    },
  };
  return res as unknown as VercelResponse & { statusCode: number; body: unknown };
}

describe("api/webhook", () => {
  afterEach(() => {
    vi.clearAllMocks();
  });

  it("returns 200 for a valid update", async () => {
    loadConfig.mockReturnValue({
      botToken: "t",
      supabaseUrl: "u",
      supabaseKey: "k",
    });
    handleUpdate.mockResolvedValue(undefined);

    const req = { body: { update_id: 1 } } as unknown as VercelRequest;
    const res = mockRes();

    await handler(req, res);

    expect(res.statusCode).toBe(200);
    expect(handleUpdate).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
  });

  it("returns 500 when config is missing", async () => {
    loadConfig.mockImplementation(() => {
      throw new Error("Missing required environment variable: BOT_TOKEN");
    });

    const req = { body: { update_id: 1 } } as unknown as VercelRequest;
    const res = mockRes();

    await handler(req, res);

    expect(res.statusCode).toBe(500);
    expect(handleUpdate).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });

  it("still returns 200 when the handler throws (handled outcome)", async () => {
    loadConfig.mockReturnValue({
      botToken: "t",
      supabaseUrl: "u",
      supabaseKey: "k",
    });
    handleUpdate.mockRejectedValue(new Error("boom"));

    const req = { body: { update_id: 1 } } as unknown as VercelRequest;
    const res = mockRes();

    await handler(req, res);

    expect(res.statusCode).toBe(200);
  });
});
